title: QA Engineer - O2C & Enterprise Billing Testing
description: We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us! We are looking for a highly analytical and technically proficient QA Engineer to take ownership of our Opportunity-to-Cash (O2C) and Enterprise Billing testing. In this role, you will act as a quality gatekeeper for the financial systems that drive our business. You will join the BOBA Frameworks QA team — a small, high-ownership team embedded in the Finance engineering organization — where quality directly impacts revenue accuracy and customer trust. You will not just be executing test cases; you will be mapping out complex data flows that span across Salesforce CPQ, our middleware, our Billing Platform, our payment gateways (Braintree), and our NetSuite ERP. If you are a critical thinker who understands the financial domino effect of a failed sync, loves unraveling usage-based billing logic, and thrives in cross-functional collaboration, we want you on our team. What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities) End-to-End Pipeline Ownership: Execute comprehensive test strategies for our entire Opportunity-to-Cash lifecycle. Trace data payloads from the moment an order is created in Salesforce CPQ to the moment the final journal entry hits NetSuite. Complex Billing Lifecycle Validation: Take ownership of testing our Enterprise Billing Platform. Rigorously validate invoice generation, taxation (Avalara), proration, discounts, credits, tiered and usage-based pricing models, credit memo issuances, and dunning (collections) workflows. Test Plan & Coverage Ownership: Own and maintain structured test plans in Xray for all buying programs (PAYG, Savings Plan, Volume Plan). Ensure traceability from requirements to execution across every billing lifecycle stage. Payment Gateway & Ledger Allocation Testing: Take ownership of end-to-end payment flows through Braintree. Validate successful authorizations, settlements, and complex edge cases like partial refunds on multi-invoice payments. Ensure funds are accurately handled (e.g., proper allocation vs. unallocated amounts) and invoice statuses remain correct across systems. Usage & Consumption Testing: Deep-dive into our usage-based billing models. Simulate high-volume usage data, validate tier drawdown logic, and ensure overages are calculated with absolute precision. Cross-System Integration Testing: Perform robust integration testing across our financial tech stack. Validate API payloads, investigate failed background syncs, and ensure data integrity between Salesforce, Billing Platform, NetSuite, and Braintree. Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis: Investigate system logs and identify exactly where a data sync broke down. Provide developers with clear, actionable reproduction steps beyond just reporting bugs. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the bridge between Engineering, Product, and Finance.Partner with business stakeholders to understand complex revenue rules and translate them into foolproof test scenarios. What Success Looks Like (Your First Year) Day 30 — Architecture & Ownership: You've mapped the full Quote-to-Cash pipeline end-to-end: Salesforce CPQ → Boomi/PASS provisioning → Billing Platform → NetSuite → Avalara & Braintree. You've taken full ownership of the Xray test repository and can explain which test cases cover which buying program, workstream, and billing lifecycle stage without being asked. Day 60 — Independent Execution: You independently execute QA for a complete enterprise billing lifecycle — from contract activation through invoice approval, tax calculation, and payment processing — and close it without escalation. You've begun triaging Billing Platform → NetSuite sync failures and Boomi provisioning errors on your own, and you understand the difference between a defect and expected system behavior. Day 90 — Primary Sign-Off: You are the QA gate for all cross-system financial deployments. Engineering ships nothing that touches CPQ, Billing Platform, or NetSuite without your sign-off. You've established a defect triage process in Jira and Xray that gives Engineering and Finance a shared, real-time view of quality — eliminating the back-and-forth that slows down deployments. Year 1 — Measurable Impact: Critical post-deployment data sync errors between CPQ and NetSuite have dropped measurably. Every active buying program — PAYG, Savings Plan, and Volume Plan — has standardized, Xray-tracked test coverage for usage-based billing, commitment invoicing, contract lifecycle boundaries, and edge cases. The team ships faster because QA is a multiplier, not a bottleneck. What You Bring to the Table (Required Experience) O2C Domain Expertise: 4+ years of QA experience with a heavy focus on Quote-to-Cash / Order-to-Cash business processes. You understand the "why" behind financial transactions, not just the "how." Salesforce CPQ: Hands-on experience configuring and testing quotes, product bundles, amendments, and contract renewals within Salesforce CPQ. Enterprise Billing Platforms: Proven experience testing complex billing systems such as BillingPlatform, Zuora, or similar financial engines. Payment Processing & Gateways: Hands-on experience testing enterprise payment gateways (Braintree heavily preferred; Stripe or Adyen acceptable). You possess a deep functional understanding of payment lifecycles (Auth, Capture, Settle, Refund) and how gateway actions impact Accounts Receivable (AR) balances. Integration Middleware: Familiarity with provisioning and event-driven middleware (Boomi or equivalent). You can read a payload log and identify where in the chain a sync broke. Test Management & Agile Tools: Proficient in Jira for defect tracking and Agile workflows, with strong hands-on experience using Xray as a test management tool. You know how to navigate structured test plans, manage test executions, and maintain strict traceability between bugs, test cases, and product requirements. Usage-Based Models: Familiarity with testing consumption-based pricing, tiered pricing, drawdown models, and metered billing logic. Integration & API Verification: Experience validating data transfers between systems (using tools like Postman or validating middleware logs). You know how to prove a system sent the right data even if the UI hasn't updated yet. Taxation & Compliance Tools: Familiarity with enterprise taxation calculation software like Avalara. Who You Are (Soft Skills) A System-Level Thinker: You understand that missing a prerequisite step — like failing to approve a usage invoice before uploading the next month's consumption — breaks the entire downstream flow. Self-Driven Investigator: When a test fails, you don't just throw it back to Dev. You dig into the documentation and logs to help figure out exactly what went wrong. Exceptional Communicator: You can clearly explain a complex API sync failure to an engineer, and then turn around and explain the business impact of that failure to a Finance Manager. Detail-Obsessive Under Ambiguity: Financial test data is rarely clean. You know how to set up a controlled test environment, isolate variables, and still reach a confident pass/fail verdict even when upstream systems are noisy. Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com . We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid. Our hiring process In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance . Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic. New Relic develops and distributes encryption software and technology that complies with U.S. export controls and licensing requirements. Certain New Relic roles require candidates to pass an export compliance assessment as a condition of employment in any global location. If relevant, we will provide more information later in the application process. Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics. Review our Applicant Privacy Notice at https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/applicant-privacy-policy

title: Staff Software Engineer - Files Platform
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are currently seeking a staff software engineer to join Addepar's Files Platform team! This team is responsible for Addepar's enterprise file management platform — building the distributed systems that power secure file storage, access control, and third-party integrations for wealth management firms.                                                                                                                                                                          

In this role, you'll tackle challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and enterprise-scale access control — designing solutions that scale from small advisory firms to the largest wealth managers in the world.

We want people who are excited by hard distributed systems problems: designing idempotent event-driven pipelines and building infrastructure that handles bursty workloads while meeting strict latency SLAs. If you've built systems that reconcile state across service boundaries, worked on event-driven architectures at scale, or are passionate about solving complex authorization and data access problems, join us!

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect, implement, and maintain backend services that manage file storage, permissions synchronization, and third-party integrations at enterprise scale — writing well-designed, testable code.
  • Design and build event-driven systems for real-time permission propagation across Addepar's financial graph and external storage providers, meeting compliance revocation SLAs.
  • Collaborate effectively with product managers, engineers, security, and compliance partners on projects involving sensitive data access controls.
  • Contribute to migration efforts (e.g., FileVault to Box, webhook consolidation, folder structure evolution) ensuring zero-downtime rollouts for production firms.
  • Mentor other engineers on the team and promote engineering best practices and principles.
  • Explore and build AI-powered capabilities for intelligent file processing, automated metadata extraction, and content-aware workflows

  • B.S., or M.S. in Computer Science or similar technical field of study 
  • Experience with server-side languages like Java, Python, or C++
  • Experience with relational databases (MySQL, Postgres, SQL Server)
  • Ability to complete complex projects involving partners across multiple teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • [Bonus] Experience with building scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS
  • [Bonus] Working with File System vendors

title: Senior Engineer, Data Platform
description:
As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you will build and operate the data infrastructure that supports Zeta’s products, analytics, machine learning, and AI systems.

This is a broad platform role. Engineers on the team take ownership across Lakehouse architecture, distributed compute, data quality, governance, lineage, security, access controls, and the operational systems that keep the platform running. Individual focus areas will change with team priorities, and you will contribute across the platform as needed. 

The team also develops tooling for type-safe, testable data pipelines and operates Spark workloads on dynamically sized Hadoop clusters backed by EC2 Spot instances. We work closely with data engineers, data scientists, infrastructure teams, and product teams to make data dependable, easy to find, secure to use, and cost-effective to process.

 

 Responsibilities:

  • Build and operate Lakehouse, Spark, and distributed data-processing systems. 
  • Improve the performance, reliability, cost, and operational visibility of platform workloads. 
  • Develop capabilities for data quality, governance, lineage, metadata, discoverability, security, and access control. 
  • Build the data context required for trusted reporting, ML models, and AI agents. 
  • Evaluate compute and query engines for read-heavy workloads, assessing cost, performance, reliability, and operational fit. 
  • Assess real-time OLAP technologies and identify appropriate production use cases. 
  • Improve deployment, observability, incident response, developer tooling, and platform operations. 
  • Partner with data scientists and data engineers to improve their experience using the platform. 
  • Contribute fixes and improvements to relevant open-source projects, including Spark, Iceberg, and Airflow. 
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing, design discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. 

 

 Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience. 
  • Strong experience in Python, Scala, Java, or another JVM language. 
  • Experience with Spark or another distributed data-processing framework. 
  • Experience building or operating production data platforms, backend systems, or distributed systems. 
  • Familiarity with at least 1 of these areas: Lakehouse architecture, Apache Iceberg, data quality, governance, lineage, metadata, query engines, or real-time OLAP. 
  • Working knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, S3, Athena, and IAM. 
  • Experience improving production reliability through monitoring, alerting, deployment automation, and incident response. 
  • Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills. 
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, Airflow, Trino, ClickHouse, Starrocks, or Pinot is a plus. 

 

 Company Summary:

 Zeta Global is a data-powered marketing technology company with a heritage of innovation and industry leadership. Founded in 2007 by entrepreneur David A. Steinberg and John Sculley, former CEO of Apple Inc and Pepsi-Cola, the Company combines the industry’s 3rd largest proprietary data set (2.4B+ identities) with Artificial Intelligence to unlock consumer intent, personalize experiences and help our clients drive business growth.

 

Zeta Global is a leading AI-powered marketing technology company that enables enterprise brands to acquire, grow, and retain customers through intelligent, data-driven engagement. At the center of its innovation is the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), which unifies customer data, identity, and advanced analytics to transform billions of data signals into actionable marketing intelligence and measurable business outcomes.

 

Publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: ZETA), Zeta is redefining modern marketing with Athena by Zeta™, a superintelligent, conversational agent embedded in ZMP that personalizes the marketer’s workspace, surfaces platform generated insights through natural dialogue and recommends next-best actions to help brands accelerate and optimize their marketing outcomes.

 

Learn more about Zeta:

https://zetaglobal.com/press-news/

title: Client Experience Specialist

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA 

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

title: Account Executive - Core
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are currently seeking an Account Executive to join our Sales Team! We are looking for a superstar to add to our ever-expanding team. We are seeking an experienced, quota-carrying sales performer who is looking to help grow Addepar to be the financial platform for the Finance Industry. The Account Executive will be responsible for growing new ARR for large RIAs’, Multi-Family Offices and Private Banks. 

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and execute a territory plan to identify, qualify, and close new business within a named account list of RIAs, Family Offices, and Multi-Family offices (up to $1.5B in Assets under management)
  • Own the full sales cycle on deals from initial outreach and discovery through demo, proposal, negotiation, and close
  • Aggressively prospect and build a pipeline through outbound outreach, referrals, events, and inbound lead follow-up
  • Conduct compelling product demonstrations that connect Addepar’s platform capabilities to each prospect’s specific operational challenges
  • Engage decision-makers at the VP and C-suite level, including COOs, CTOs, and firm principals
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecast in Salesforce, with consistent hygiene and timely updates
  • Partner with Pre-sales and Client Success to engage smooth handoffs and a strong client experience through onboarding 
  • Represent Addepar at industry events, conferences, and prospect meetings (40-50% travel expected)

Who You Are

  • 4+years of experience in software or SaaS sales, with a track record of meeting or exceeding quota
  • Experience selling into the wealth management or financial services industry, with familiarity with RIA and family office business models
  • Proven ability to run a structured sales process end-to-end, including discovery, demo, and close
  • Comfortable engaging VP and C-suite stakeholders in financial services firms
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce for pipeline and activity management
  • Strong presentation and communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Proficiency with web conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, etc.)
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Bachelor’s degree 

You Will Also Bring

  • Intellectual curiosity about fintech and wealth management - you want to understand the industry, not just sell into it
  • Coachability and a growth mindset; you actively seek feedback and apply it
  • A competitive drive balanced with a collaborative, team-first attitude
  • Strong organizational skills and the discipline to manage a high-volume pipeline

Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for this role within the United States.

Compensation for this role includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Base Salary Range
$108,000—$120,000 USD

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

title: Customer Operations - Lead
description:
About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the Role:

As the Customer Operations Lead at Ethos, you will lead a team of up to 10 -12 Associates, ensuring they deliver an exceptional experience to new and existing customers and the insurance agents who refer business to Ethos. You will combine hands-on customer support leadership with team management, coaching, and process improvement to drive team performance and customer satisfaction.This role requires strong people-leadership skills alongside the deep product, systems, and communication expertise expected of frontline associates.Creating a positive customer and agent experience is critical to Ethos's success in the life insurance industry, and this role is central to scaling that experience through a high-performing team.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & People Management
- Directly manage, coach, and develop a team of up to 10 Customer Operations Associates
- Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations
- Set individual and team goals aligned with broader Customer Operations objectives, and track progress against defined service levels (SLAs)
- Manage team scheduling, staffing coverage, and workload distribution across email, live chat, SMS, and phone channels
- Recruit, onboard, and train new team members; build and maintain onboarding/training materials
- Foster a positive, accountable, and high-performance team culture

Operational Excellence
- Ensure the team maintains accuracy in all communications with customers/agents on policy /agent comp related queries
- Own team-level quality assurance — audit interactions, provide feedback, and drive continuous improvement in service quality
- Monitor team metrics (response times, resolution rates, CSAT/agent satisfaction, SLA adherence) and report performance to management

Process & Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Identify opportunities for process improvements across the team's functions and lead implementation of agreed-upon solutions
- Partner with other cross-functional teams to resolve systemic issues and represent the voice of the customer/agent
- Develop and maintain team knowledge base, playbooks, and SOPs to ensure consistency and scalability
- Support hiring, capacity planning, and resource forecasting as the team grows

Subject Matter Expertise
- Maintain and deepen expert-level understanding of Ethos products, consumer policy systems, and partner agent systems
- Serve as the team's go-to resource for complex queries/scenarios 

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 3-5+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, or operations, including at least 1-2 years in a team lead, supervisor, or people management role
  • Proven experience managing and developing a team of 5+ direct reports
  • Experience in life insurance or a related industry strongly preferred
  • Bachelor's degree preferred
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or equivalent support/help desk software; experience with reporting/dashboarding tools a plus
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret team performance data and translate it into action
  • Excellent coaching, feedback delivery, and conflict-resolution skills
  • Adaptable and resilient, able to lead a team through change while maintaining quality and morale
  • Excellent phone presence, written communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills

#LI-Onsite

#LI-MS1

  • Execution and Optimization for Paid campaigns across social media platforms

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary and Impact

This role sits within the Client Leadership & Planning practice at WPP Media, where you will lead integrated media strategy and client partnerships for one of the organization’s key accounts. As Senior Vice President, Client Services, you will drive end-to-end strategic planning, business growth, and client success by delivering integrated marketing solutions across offline, digital, commerce, and emerging media channels.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, translating business objectives into insight-led media strategies that deliver measurable outcomes. Working closely with specialists across Planning, Investment, Commerce, Data, Analytics, Creative, and Technology, you will ensure seamless execution while fostering innovation and collaboration across teams.

This role also plays a critical leadership function by developing high-performing teams, strengthening client relationships, driving strategic excellence, and championing the adoption of WPP Open and AI-enabled planning capabilities to deliver future-ready marketing solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Client Leadership & Strategic Planning

  • Lead the development of integrated media and communication strategies aligned with client business objectives and long-term growth ambitions.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, acting as a strategic advisor across planning, investment, and business transformation initiatives.
  • Translate business challenges into actionable, insight-led media strategies that deliver measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Lead strategic planning across annual business plans, campaign roadmaps, product launches, and integrated marketing initiatives.

Digital Media Planning & Campaign Excellence

  • Develop end-to-end media strategies across digital, commerce, social, search, and emerging media platforms.
  • Partner with specialist teams to deliver integrated planning solutions that maximise marketing effectiveness and business performance.
  • Ensure media plans are supported by audience intelligence, market insights, data analytics, and robust measurement frameworks.
  • Drive excellence in campaign execution by maintaining high standards of planning quality, governance, and operational efficiency.

Data, Insights & Innovation

  • Leverage consumer insights, audience data, category intelligence, and market trends to identify growth opportunities for clients.
  • Interpret complex data and research to develop compelling strategic recommendations and business narratives.
  • Champion innovation by introducing new planning methodologies, AI-powered capabilities, and emerging media solutions.
  • Encourage the adoption of WPP Open and advanced planning tools to improve strategic decision-making and campaign performance.

Client Growth & Business Development

  • Identify opportunities to expand client partnerships through proactive strategic recommendations and innovative marketing solutions.
  • Support new business pitches by developing integrated communication strategies and presenting compelling client solutions.
  • Drive thought leadership by sharing industry trends, best practices, and award-winning work across internal and client teams.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement by initiating cross-category learning, strategic case studies, and innovation programmes.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing planning team while promoting collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Build a culture of strategic excellence by coaching team members on planning frameworks, storytelling, client management, and presentation skills.
  • Collaborate across the wider WPP Media network to unlock specialist capabilities and integrated client solutions.
  • Ensure effective resource planning, performance management, and talent development across the team.

Skills & Competencies

  • Extensive experience in digital media planning, client leadership, and strategic communications.
  • Deep understanding of offline and digital media ecosystems, audience planning, marketing effectiveness, and business strategy.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate business objectives into integrated marketing solutions.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Outstanding stakeholder management, client servicing, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong presentation, storytelling, and executive communication skills with experience engaging senior client stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams within a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and driving measurable business outcomes.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Advertising, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification or MBA is preferred.
  • 14+ years of experience in Media Planning, Client Leadership, Integrated Communications, or Strategic Marketing, including experience in a senior leadership role.
  • Proven experience managing large client portfolios and developing integrated media strategies across traditional and digital channels.
  • Strong understanding of media planning, media buying, audience measurement, brand investment, and marketing analytics.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams, mentoring talent, and driving business growth.
  • Experience working with leading brands across automotive, FMCG, technology, or similar sectors will be an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of AI-enabled planning tools, audience intelligence platforms, and data-driven marketing methodologies is preferred.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. title: Services Sales Consultant
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

The Services Sales Consultant (SSC) plays a critical role in shaping the implementation journey for prospective and existing clients across the EMEA region. This role partners closely with Sales to define, position, and sell professional services delivered by Addepar and Addepar-certified partners.

The SSC is deeply knowledgeable in implementation and adoption methodologies and ensures that services engagements are positioned as win-win outcomes for both clients and Addepar. They tailor best-practice implementation approaches, roles, and technology recommendations to meet client requirements and regional market needs.

During the sales process, the SSC works closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineers, and other Go-To-Market (GTM) partners, engaging with stakeholders ranging from C-suite executives to operational leaders to structure and sell professional services engagements.

This is a highly visible opportunity to gain broader exposure within Addepar’s GTM organisation, contribute directly to revenue growth, and deepen understanding of Addepar’s sales motion, positioning, and client strategy across the UK and EMEA markets.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Represent Professional Services in sales cycles for both prospects and existing clients, partnering with Sales to develop high-quality services proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), and commercial terms
  • Collaborate with the Sales organisation on assigned opportunities to define and execute the services strategy
  • Understand customer needs and the competitive landscape in the UK and EMEA markets to effectively position the value of Addepar Professional Services
  • Present Addepar Services offerings and value propositions to prospective and existing clients
  • Partner with Professional Services delivery teams and Solutions Engineers to scope services required to support Addepar technology implementations, integrations, and scale

title: Risk Analyst
description:
IMC is currently looking for a Risk Analyst to join our growing team in Mumbai. This person will be responsible for identifying and assessing risks, determining adequate controls, and developing risk metrics and tools to monitor market, credit, liquidity, and operational risks.

 

Your Core Responsibilities: 

  • Monitor intraday and overnight market risk exposure of our trading activities and work closely with trading desks to adjust strategies accordingly
  • Analyse market trends, stay informed on events in the macro calendar and conduct stress tests to assess impacts and potential risks to the trading book
  • Maintain an open line of communication with trading desks and implement risk mitigation strategies that hedge against adverse events
  • Utilize Python-based tools and libraries for stress testing, and scenario analysis as well as generally designing and contributing to local risk management tooling
  • Engage key stakeholders through operational incident management process to help structurally improve infrastructure, processes or governance
  • Partner with software development, data engineering, and trading support to implement solutions into IMC’s proprietary global risk management system
  • Collaborate with global risk, trading, and technology teams to design and employ/deploy risk controls in IMC’s proprietary trading system
  • Generate key risk management reports and present findings to senior management
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk management policies
  • Provide training and support to traders on risk tools, methodologies, and best practices

 

Your Skills and Experience: 

  • 3+ years of relevant professional work experience with a capital markets company required
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field of study with strong academic performance
  • Proficiency in Python programming language with demonstrated experience in conducting data analysis, scripting, dashboard and tool development required
  • Experience with Python (e.g., Pandas, Standard Library, and any visualisation library) and SQL required
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency with quantitative analysis and modelling required
  • Financial Risk Management (FRM) or NISM Series VII preferred but not required
  • Familiarity with financial markets, derivatives, stress testing, risk management tools and frameworks preferred but not required
  • Experience with analysing and managing risks associated with a portfolio of equities, futures, and options preferred but not required
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Proactive attitude and out-of-the-box thinker who excels in a fast-paced, high-pressured environment

About Us

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

title: Lead Compliance Analyst
description:
About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role

Ethos is seeking an experienced Lead Compliance Analyst. This role requires deep analytical skills to drive the identification of compliance risk and actionable insights across various data sources. This role requires expertise in at least one compliance domain, with growing proficiency in a second. A successful candidate will be fully self-sufficient, with the judgment to operate with minimal oversight, and be capable of designing and improving processes for greater efficiency and effectiveness.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Analyze large, disparate data sets to identify compliance risk trends, control gaps, outliers, and emerging exposures, and quantify their significance for the business
  • Build, maintain and evolve recurring risk analytics: dashboards, key risk indicators, and monitoring queries that give leadership a continuous view rather than a point-in-time snapshot.
  • Translate findings into analyses and verbal briefings for compliance leadership and business stakeholders
  • Lead responses to regulatory inquiries and examinations from initial scoping through final submission, continuously improving the intake and documentation process, and analyzing inquiry trends for early insight into regulatory focus and emerging risk
  • Coordinate with key stakeholders to lead the annual third party administrator license renewal process, including identifying and resolving jurisdictional and/or procedural complications
  • Support the ongoing evolution of the company’s compliance program as the business continues to scale and embark on new initiatives which may present novel risks
  • Evaluate current policies and procedures and independently design, propose, and implement new or enhanced practices with limited oversight
  • Independently define and lead at least one major team initiative per quarter

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 5+ years of regulatory and/or insurance compliance, risk, or audit experience, with demonstrated depth in at least one functional area (e.g., data privacy, AI, sales practices, marketing/advertising) and growing expertise in a second
  • Deep analytical skills: the ability to draw data from many different systems and sources, connect it into a coherent view, and identify the risk patterns and insights that aren't visible in any single data set on its own
  • Proven ability to operate independently and drive outcomes with little day-to-day oversight; track record of building or materially improving compliance processes, not just following them
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior stakeholders
  • Strong ability to actively identify and cultivate relationships with key stakeholders, considers stakeholder management for all key initiatives, and understands and works to overcome what is needed to gain buy-in
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to business partners on compliance matters, including in ambiguous or first-of-their-kind situations
  • Demonstrates intellectual rigor by knowing the right questions to ask, building an approach to gather the data to answer them, and adjusting strategy accordingly
  • When faced with ambiguity or adversity, ability to demonstrate a solutions-oriented mindset by developing a plan of action and being able to help others do the same
  • Proficiency using Google and MS Office tools
  • Expertise in life insurance products and industry laws/regulations/rules is strongly preferred 
  • Bachelor's degree in risk management, business, marketing,or a related field, or equivalent education and experience

#LI-Hybrid

#LI-KP2

title: Intern - Culture & Experiences
description:
At Kulfi Collective, we are a diverse team of storytellers, technologists, and cultural enthusiasts who believe in the power of content to shape minds and inspire change. We are on a mission to create original and branded content that resonates with Gen Y and Gen Z audiences, merging authentic narratives with cutting-edge digital experiences.

THE KIND OF WORK YOU'LL SHAPE
At Kulfi, culture isn't something that happens between work. It's part of the work. We're constantly thinking about how people experience Kulfi - through the things we build, the communities we bring together, the spaces we create, and the moments that give people a reason to come together.

THE ROLE
You'll work with the People & Culture team across the process of building these experiences - from finding the initial spark and researching references, to shaping ideas, putting together moodboards, coordinating the moving pieces and seeing things come to life.

WHAT YOU'LL DRIVE

  • Research ideas, references, spaces, communities, merch and cultural moments that could inspire what we build next
  • Help turn a thought into a concept, moodboard, format or experience
  • Support planning and execution across different culture and experience-led projects
  • Contribute ideas for new ways to build culture, community and connection at Kulfi
  • Be part of on-ground execution and see projects through to the finish
  • Capture learnings and references along the way so we can keep building on what we've done

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

  • You'll get to work with a team that's constantly experimenting with new ways to build spaces, create merch and engage with people/communities.
  • While execution is a big part of the role, you'll also get to see the thinking behind culture-building.
  • The work will move between bigger and smaller projects, giving you room to experiment and try different things.
  • You'll work closely with the People & Culture team, while also collaborating with folks across Marketing, Creative Tech, Creative Direction, Production and more - giving you plenty of opportunities to learn across the floor.

WHO YOU ARE

BEFORE YOU APPLY

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team at Kulfi Collective. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, and strive to create a culture that values and respects diversity.

title: Associate Director, Sports & Entertainment, India
description:
About WPP Media

About WPP Media 

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com. 

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com 

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values: 

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. 
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. 
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. 

WPP Media, is looking for a Director – Film & OTT Associations to join its Content team, working on one of India’s largest and most diverse FMCG portfolios. The role sits at the intersection of brands, entertainment and popular culture, identifying and building meaningful partnerships across Bollywood, regional cinema, OTT platforms and streaming content. We are looking for someone who combines strong entertainment instincts with strategic, creative and operational rigour. The individual should understand how brands can participate naturally within the world of films and streaming content, while ensuring that every association delivers against clearly defined brand and business objectives. This is a high-intensity role involving complex partnerships that can run across three to six months, from opportunity identification and creative development to production, amplification and post-campaign evaluation.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Opportunity Identification & Curation
  • Identify relevant upcoming films, OTT shows, talent and entertainment properties based on brand requirements and cultural opportunities.
  • Proactively curate opportunities across Bollywood, Hollywood, regional cinema and streaming platforms.
  • Evaluate opportunities through a combination of audience fit, cultural relevance, content context, reach and brand objectives.
  1. Strategy & Creative Development
  • Translate brand briefs and business problems into compelling Film and OTT partnership ideas.
  • Work closely with production houses, studios, platforms, creators and internal teams to develop data-backed and creatively strong brand integrations.
  • Ensure integrations feel authentic to the narrative rather than forced brand placements.
  1. Partnership & Campaign Management
  • Lead projects end to end across negotiations, creative development, production, approvals, asset delivery and amplification.
  • Manage multiple stakeholders and complex timelines while ensuring campaigns are delivered to the highest quality standards.
  • Build strong relationships across production houses, studios, OTT platforms, talent ecosystems and other entertainment partners.
  1. Execution Excellence
  • Protect the creative integrity of every association while ensuring clear and meaningful brand visibility.
  • Work closely with partners during production and post-production to deliver all committed integration and amplification assets.
  • Anticipate challenges and solve for changes that may arise during the course of production or campaign rollout.
  1. Campaign Monitoring & Optimization
  • Track campaign performance and recommend interventions or amplification opportunities where relevant.
  • Work closely with content, planning and buying teams to maximise the impact of the partnership beyond the core integration.
  1. Measurement & Learning
  • Build comprehensive campaign reports linked back to the objectives defined at the outset.
  • Conduct post-campaign evaluations covering brand, media, content and cultural impact.
  • Develop learnings and best practices that improve future Film and OTT partnerships.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 3 months

  • Develop a strong understanding of the portfolio of brands, agency ecosystem and ways of working.
  • Independently manage Film and OTT campaigns from briefing through execution and reporting.
  • Proactively bring new opportunities and thinking to brands rather than responding only to briefs.

In 6 months

  • Build strategic annual Film and OTT opportunity plans across priority brands.
  • Increase the number of brands meaningfully participating in entertainment partnerships.
  • Develop a strong understanding of emerging trends across films, streaming, talent and audience behaviour.
  • Establish strong working relationships with key studios, production houses, platforms and internal stakeholders.

In 12 months

  • Establish best practices and frameworks for Film and OTT partnerships.
  • Become a trusted thought partner to brands on entertainment and popular culture.
  • Build a differentiated pipeline of partnerships across Bollywood, regional cinema and OTT.
  • Deliver against agreed annual business, partnership and campaign objectives.

What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience across entertainment marketing, branded content, film partnerships, OTT partnerships, studios, production houses or related businesses.
  • Prior experience working on film integrations, movie marketing partnerships, OTT associations or branded entertainment is strongly preferred.
  • Graduate degree mandatory; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong understanding of the Indian film, streaming and entertainment ecosystem.
  • Strong creative judgement coupled with the ability to evaluate opportunities strategically and commercially.
  • Excellent project-management skills and the ability to manage complex, long-gestation campaigns involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong presentation, communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Understanding of social media, digital marketing, content marketing and media amplification.
  • Proficiency in at least one Indian regional language is preferred but not mandatory.
  • Hands on Experience in pre and post-production will be an added advantage.

Core expectations from the role  

  1. Work across some of India’s largest brands
    Build entertainment partnerships for a diverse portfolio of leading FMCG brands.
  2. Put brands at the heart of popular culture
    Work across films, streaming, talent and entertainment to create partnerships audiences genuinely want to engage with.
  3. Operate at extraordinary scale
    Be part of Mindshare and WPP Media, working within one of the largest media and marketing ecosystems in India.

 

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. 

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data
description:
Aliases: Project Manager, Program Manager, Product Manager, Data Operations Lead, Data Delivery Lead, Technical Delivery Lead, or Data Governance Lead.

About Truveta 

Truveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values. 

This opportunity 

Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early employees, you will help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub. 

You will be the program owner for the Data Platform work carried out in India. That means the data-source onboarding, the processing and quality programs, the governance and access work, and the release and adoption of what the team builds. It is a single, senior, hands-off-the-keyboard role with real accountability and no direct reports. 

Who we need 

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead complex, cross-functional programs across data acquisition, data processing, data quality, governance, platform delivery, and data-product adoption. You will work closely with engineering, data engineering, product, data science, operations, security, compliance, and business stakeholders to convert ambiguous data challenges into clear programs, measurable outcomes, and reliable production capabilities. 

You will have built systems and we expect you to read an architecture diagram without help, to follow a design review closely enough to ask the question everyone else missed, and to know from experience which risks are worth a week of the team's time and which are not. You will not have formal authority over the teams you depend on, so the job is done through clarity, technical credibility, and follow-through. 

What you will do 

In this role you will: 

  • Own programs from problem definition and planning through delivery, adoption, and post-launch measurement. 
  • Build and maintain roadmaps, milestones, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and the delivery mechanisms that keep them useful. 
  • Partner with engineering and data teams on architecture, technical constraints, sequencing, and delivery risk, at a depth that lets you challenge the plan rather than only record it. 
  • Coordinate data-source onboarding, ingestion, transformation, normalization, enrichment, and validation programs. 
  • Drive resolution of data-quality issues, operational defects, and recurring pipeline failures, including the root-cause work that stops them recurring. 
  • Coordinate data governance, access control, privacy, security, metadata, lineage, and compliance initiatives. 
  • Identify cross-team blockers and drive them to resolution without relying on formal authority. 
  • Facilitate technical reviews and ensure major decisions, trade-offs, assumptions, and risks are written down where people will find them. 
  • Coordinate launch readiness, release management, operational support, and post-launch reviews. 
  • Prepare clear written updates and recommendations for engineering and business leadership across India and Seattle. 
  • Improve program management practice, reporting automation, delivery predictability, and operational maturity at the site. 

Required qualifications 

The experience requirement is 11+ years in total, composed of 7+ years in a hands-on individual-contributor technical role and 4+ years in a technical program or project management role. The two are counted separately and added; a year spent doing both is counted once. 

  • At least 11 years of professional experience in total. 
  • At least 7 years in a hands-on individual-contributor in technical roles such as software engineering, quality assurance, data engineering, analytics engineering, systems engineering, or platform engineering. 
  • At least 4 years in a technical program management or technical project management role, owning delivery across engineering teams. 
  • Experience delivering programs involving data platforms, data pipelines, data governance, analytics infrastructure, or distributed systems. 
  • Working knowledge of data ingestion, ETL and ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and data quality. 
  • Ability to read architecture diagrams and hold a substantive conversation with engineers about designs, trade-offs, dependencies, and operational risk. 
  • Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams, driving requirements, delivery plans, risk management, release readiness, and adoption. 
  • Strong written communication, including executive status reporting and written recommendations that carry out a decision. 
  • Ability to operate in ambiguity and influencing teams. 
  • Familiarity with Agile development, release processes, incident management, and production operations. 
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred qualifications 

The following skill sets would be good to have:

  • SQL or equivalent data-querying ability used in practice rather than in principle. 
  • Hands-on background with Kafka, Spark, Flink, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, AWS Glue, or comparable platforms. 
  • Experience with data governance, metadata, data lineage, access control, privacy, security, or compliance programs. 
  • Experience with external data suppliers, healthcare data, financial data, or other regulated datasets. 
  • Experience operating data platforms against measurable uptime, freshness, accuracy, completeness, latency, and cost targets. 
  • Experience managing distributed programs across India and the United States. 
  • Experience standing up program management practice at a new site or in a new platform area. 
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Aha, Linear, Asana, Smartsheet, or equivalent tools.

description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

The Advisor Experience team is a new engineering team within Addepar’s Core Product Engineering organization, focused on building the products and experiences that define how financial advisors and their clients interact on the Addepar platform. Initially this role will focus on our new Secure Message Center — a compliant messaging experience built into Addepar’s client portal — but the scope extends well beyond messaging. We’re building the connective tissue between advisors and the investors they serve, creating workflows that make every interaction more informed, more personal, and more seamless.

As the Engineering Manager for this team, you’ll lead a small, growing group of engineers and shape both the technical direction and team culture from the early stages. You’ll partner closely with product management and design to translate an ambitious product vision into shipped software.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of full-stack engineers, building a culture of accountability, quality, and continuous improvement from the ground up.
  • Partner with product management and design to define roadmaps, prioritize work, and deliver on initiatives that directly shape the advisor-client experience on Addepar's platform.
  • Own the team's technical direction — guide architecture decisions, conduct design reviews, and stay close enough to the codebase to provide meaningful feedback in code reviews.
  • Drive execution across the team using well-defined goal-setting frameworks, balancing ambitious delivery targets with sustainable engineering practices.
  • Recruit and hire engineers as the team grows, setting a high bar for both technical ability and collaborative fit.
  • Collaborate across engineering teams to ensure the Advisor Experience products integrate cleanly with Addepar's broader platform — including the client portal, reporting infrastructure, and data layer.
  • Champion operational excellence — own the team's approach to testing, deployment, incident response, and technical debt management.

  • You have 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a people management or team leadership role.
  • You have a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have a strong full-stack technical background — you're comfortable reviewing architecture across the stack, from Java or similar backend systems to modern frontend frameworks like React, Ember, or Svelte.
  • You're an effective technical leader who doesn't need to write every line of code but stays close enough to the work to guide design decisions, unblock engineers, and maintain high standards in code review.
  • You have experience building and growing engineering teams — whether that's hiring your first reports, structuring interview loops, or scaling a team through a period of growth.
  • You're a clear, direct communicator who can translate between technical details and business outcomes for stakeholders across product, design, and leadership.
  • You're familiar with AI-assisted development workflows and see them as a natural part of how modern engineering teams operate.
  • Experience with real-time communication systems, messaging infrastructure, or client-facing portal experiences is a strong plus.
  • You have a background or strong interest in fintech, wealth management, or financial advisor workflows.

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

The Client Success Management (CSM) team at Addepar is responsible for the complete post-sales lifecycle of a client. Through strategic guidance and partnership, CSM ensures clients derive maximum value from the platform, leading to overall adoption success, retention, and renewal. Few roles provide such a direct impact on the growth of the company.

The CSM Team manages some of Addepar’s largest and most sophisticated clients, including Single Family Offices, Multi-Family Offices and traditional Wealth Management Firms. You will become a trusted partner, deeply understanding and advising on their business, including their strategy, clients, services, team, and technology, and helping them increase the value they get from Addepar. 

This role works closely with the Account Executive, cross-functional R&D, and Services teams to effect change management and drive standard methodologies and utilization of the platform. You will be the client’s internal advocate, helping ensure an excellent experience, and capturing feedback on ways that Addepar can build the next generation of client-centric solutions.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

  • Have a deep understanding of Addepar's Key & Strategic Client segment including industry challenges, and goals, coupled with a strong understanding of how they are using Addepar to increase client adoption, growth, and ensure account retention
  • Provide strategic oversight during the entire client journey, including implementation, optimization, growth, renewal so your team can deliver a seamless handover of knowledge and responsibilities where appropriate
  • Partner with your Account Executive to deliver quarterly business reviews to align on business priorities, optimization opportunities, Addepar’s product roadmap, and to review product usage and adoption patterns and/or insights
  • Be the voice of the client to Product Management, Product Marketing, Support, Renewals, Services, Finance, etc. building strong working relationship with each to ensure client success and consistency of contact
  • Build and maintain a high level of client happiness and reference-ability by successfully diagnosing business operations of clients and prescribing appropriate solutions and Services
  • Key to the position is a strong work ethic, creativity of approaches in covering clients, sense of urgency in everything you do, and strong leadership capabilities which include building, cultivating and supporting a high-performance team, supporting team objectives and driving client success. This person must have a successful track record of: collaborating with multiple cross-functional team members, including sales, marketing, R&D, Finance and Legal; interacting regularly with senior level leaders and C-level management to ensure GTM objectives are met. They must maintain a deep understanding of Addepar technology and be able to articulate Addepar’s propositions to the partner community

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of experience or (5 years + MBA) in working in a client facing role with proven track record an in-depth knowledge of our strategic client segment
  • Strong work ethic, upbeat, proactive, standout colleague
  • Excellent problem solving, communication, organization, and time leadership skills
  • Data and metric driven
  • Flexibility and ability to adapt to new demands; strong sense of urgency
  • Assertiveness, candor, and a “company first” mentality
  • Minimum of Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for this role within the United States.

Compensation for this role includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Base Salary Range
$109,000—$163,000 USD

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

About the Role

We are seeking a seasoned Manager, Software Engineering with 12+ years of experience to lead our Database Engineering and Cloud Infrastructure team. In this role, you will lead a team of high-performing engineers responsible for architecting, scaling, and optimizing multi-cloud relational and in-memory database platforms. You will bridge technical execution, engineering leadership, and strategic infrastructure planning across AWS and Azure environments.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Lead the architectural design and operations of enterprise-grade, multi-cloud relational databases across AWS (RDS PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora) and Azure (Database for PostgreSQL/MySQL, Azure SQL Managed Instance).
  • Drive high-availability architecture strategies, including Multi-AZ deployments, auto-failover groups, read replica scaling, and cross-region disaster recovery (DR).
  • Oversee zero-downtime operations, including major-version engine upgrades, schema migrations, and blue/green deployment strategies.

In-Memory Infrastructure & Open-Source Strategy

  • Manage scale operations for in-memory datastores (AWS ElastiCache, Azure Cache for Redis), focusing on cluster mode operations, eviction policies, and persistence tuning.
  • Spearhead open-source caching initiatives and migration pathways from Redis to Valkey (e.g., AWS ElastiCache for Valkey) using zero-downtime tools like RedisShake to ensure open-source license compliance and optimize cloud spend.

Automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & DevOps

  • Enforce an IaC-first engineering culture using Terraform, OpenTofu, Bicep, or CloudFormation to eliminate manual configuration and console drift.
  • Drive automated database provisioning, drift detection, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for database schemas using tools like Flyway or Liquibase.

FinOps & Performance Optimization

  • Partner with Finance and DevOps to drive FinOps practices: conduct cost allocation, rightsizing exercises, and reserved instance / savings plan management.
  • Evaluate and implement optimal architectural tradeoffs between serverless and provisioned computing models (e.g., Aurora Serverless v2, Azure SQL Serverless).
  • Monitor performance using AWS Performance Insights and Azure Diagnostics to optimize query performance, indexing, and resource usage.

Team Management & Operational Excellence

  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of senior database and cloud infrastructure engineers.
  • Set operational standards, service level objectives (SLOs), and incident management practices for database availability, security, and scalability.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 12+ years of total software engineering / infrastructure experience, with at least 3–5 years in an engineering management or technical leadership role focused on cloud databases.
  • Multi-Cloud Mastery: Deep hands-on experience operating managed relational databases in both AWS and Azure environments at enterprise scale.
  • In-Memory & Valkey Ecosystem: Proven track record managing Redis clusters and navigating Redis-to-Valkey migration strategies to reduce operational overhead and licensing costs.
  • Automation & IaC: Mastery of Infrastructure as Code principles (Terraform, OpenTofu, Bicep, or CloudFormation) and database migration tooling (Flyway, Liquibase).
  • FinOps Expertise: Demonstrated ability to optimize multi-cloud infrastructure costs, manage serverless vs. provisioned workloads, and deliver measurable cloud cost savings (20–30%+).
  • Operations & Resiliency: Direct experience implementing automated backups, zero-downtime blue/green deployments, major version upgrades, and multi-region disaster recovery.

description:
