We are seeking an Associate Manager to lead a defined set of Forecasting workstreams and strengthen the team’s operating model.

This role goes beyond forecast production. You will own workstream performance from end to end, including forecast quality, prioritization, business readiness, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement. You will translate complex data into clear recommendations, make informed tradeoffs, and help leaders understand key risks, opportunities, and decisions.

You will also guide and develop analysts through coaching, technical support, and clear performance expectations. The ideal candidate combines analytical depth, strategic judgment, operational discipline, and strong cross functional influence.

Success in this role requires advanced SQL skills, strong business acumen, and demonstrated experience improving forecasting, planning, or operational processes at scale.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will own:

Forecasting Performance and Business Readiness

Lead demand forecasting across designated business lines and workstreams, with accountability for forecast accuracy, assumptions, risks, and recommended actions across planning horizons. Ensure forecasts reflect key demand drivers, including initiatives, promotions, operational changes, and seasonality, while establishing consistent mechanisms for performance reviews, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

End-to-End Workstream Leadership

Serve as the primary Forecasting leader for assigned workstreams. Set priorities, align stakeholders, manage delivery, and make informed tradeoffs based on customer impact, operational risk, financial impact, and team capacity. Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and decision requests for senior leaders.

Strategy, Scale, and Process Improvement

Identify and lead opportunities to improve forecasting methods, planning processes, data quality, systems, and automation. Build scalable solutions that improve accuracy, efficiency, and decision quality while adapting operating models to the needs of each business line.

Data and Technical Partnership

Partner with Data Science, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, and Software Engineering to shape forecasting capabilities. Define requirements for models, metrics, dashboards, datasets, and planning tools, resolve data and pipeline issues, and influence the roadmap for automation and machine learning.

Talent Development and Operating Excellence

title: Manager, Product Design: AI Products
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity

AI is a top strategic priority for New Relic, and the Bengaluru design team is at the center of it. The team works across three closely related product clusters: autonomous incident response (SRE Agent, Autopilot, and Intelligent RCA), the intelligence and platform layer that powers them (Ground Truth, Agentic Platform, and New Relic AI), and AIOps for event correlation and incident management. These products share a common design challenge: users need to trust systems that act autonomously, and building that trust through good design is genuinely hard work.

This is an on-site role in Bengaluru. Your designers are there, and many of your engineering and product partners are too. Being present — in standups, reviews, and the quick conversations before a decision gets made — is part of how you'll build the relationships that make design effective. You'll also collaborate with design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain, so operating across time zones and communicating well in writing are part of the job.

 

You'll manage a small team of designers and own the quality of the work across these products. The design questions here don't have established answers — how do you make an autonomous system legible? How do you build user trust in AI-generated root cause analysis? How do you design a handoff from machine decision to human judgment? If you're already working in AI product design, or actively building toward it, and you want to lead a team on problems where the playbook doesn't exist yet, this is that role.

What you'll do

  • Manage and develop your designers — run consistent 1:1s including regular career development conversations, give direct and specific feedback, set clear expectations for each person, and invest in their growth. Build a team culture where people feel they belong and different perspectives are welcome. You'll represent your team in calibration conversations and advocate for their work and careers within the broader design org.
  • Own design quality across AI Products — review work critically, raise problems before they reach partners, and make sure the team is solving the right problems at the right level of craft. For these products, that means consistently asking: does this design make the system legible? Does it earn trust or just assert it?
  • Keep the user's perspective in the conversation — design managers at New Relic are the voice of the user in product and engineering discussions. For AI products, that means bringing user research and real-world usage patterns into roadmap conversations, and pushing back when a feature optimizes for the AI's capability rather than the user's understanding of it.
  • Partner with PM and Engineering — work with your product and engineering counterparts as a peer. Hold the design perspective, push back when the direction needs it, and communicate design's value in terms the business tracks: adoption, incident resolution time, customer retention.
  • Keep the team focused and on track — manage incoming work, maintain visibility into what's in flight, help the team balance competing priorities, and set clear expectations with PM and Engineering partners about what's possible and when.
  • Help your team design for AI well — bring a genuine point of view on AI interaction design: trust, transparency, human-in-the-loop moments, designing for systems that act before the user asks. Use AI tools actively in your own workflow — Figma AI, Claude, Gemini, and others — and help your team develop theirs for faster prototyping, better research synthesis, and exploring directions that would take weeks with traditional tools.
  • Contribute IC design work when the work calls for it — you're an experienced designer, and these products are complex enough that there will be moments where the team needs your hands on a problem. Roll up your sleeves when it's the right call; delegate when it isn't.
  • Hire well — contribute to recruiting when the team has open roles. Use each hire to bring in diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and build the kind of team where different viewpoints make the work better.
  • Connect Bengaluru to the rest of the design org — bridge your team to design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain. Apply New Relic's design standards and practices locally, and make sure your team isn't developing in isolation from the broader design org direction.

This role requires

  • 8+ years of product design experience, with meaningful time on technically complex B2B or enterprise software — products with real technical users and high stakes in production
  • 2–4 years of direct people management — you've run 1:1s, given honest performance feedback, and developed designers at different career stages
  • Genuine curiosity about AI product design — ideally you're already working in this space. You have a developing point of view on trust, transparency, and human-in-the-loop design, and you can evaluate whether a design makes an autonomous system legible and trustworthy. You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and contribute design work on problems where the answers aren't settled

title: Manager, Product Design: Application Observability
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity

New Relic is hiring an on-site design manager for our Hyderabad team, leading design for Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and Log Management — two of the platform's most used products. APM gives engineering teams full-stack visibility across their applications: connecting traces, metrics, and infrastructure data so they can find what's breaking and understand why. Log Management is where engineers go to make sense of raw data at scale — ingesting, parsing, and querying log data across their entire stack, without the operational overhead of managing it separately. These are the products engineers open when something is on fire, which means the design work is high-stakes and high-visibility.

This is an on-site role in Hyderabad. Many of the engineers and product managers you'll partner with are there too, and being present — in standups, reviews, and the quick conversations before a decision gets made — is part of how you'll build the relationships that make design effective. You'll also work closely with design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain, so operating across time zones and communicating well in writing are part of the job, not an afterthought.

You'll manage a small team of designers, own the quality of design work across APM and Logs, and stay close enough to the craft to contribute directly when it matters. If you've led a small design team on complex technical products and want clear ownership of both the work and the people — this is that role.

What you'll do

  • Manage and develop your designers — run consistent 1:1s including regular career development conversations, give direct and specific feedback, set clear expectations for each person, and invest in their growth. Build a team culture where people feel they belong and different perspectives are welcome. You'll represent your team in calibration conversations and advocate for their work and careers within the broader design org.
  • Own design quality across APM and Logs — review work critically, raise problems before they reach partners, and make sure the team is solving the right problems at the right level of craft. You're accountable for what ships.
  • Keep the user's perspective in the conversation — design managers at New Relic are the voice of the user in product and engineering discussions. You bring user needs and research insights into roadmap conversations, not just design reviews.
  • Partner with PM and Engineering — work with your product and engineering counterparts as a peer. Hold the design perspective, push back when the direction needs it, and communicate design's value in terms of outcomes the business tracks: adoption, retention, time to value.
  • Keep the team focused and on track — manage incoming work, maintain visibility into what's in flight, help the team balance competing priorities, and set clear expectations with PM and Engineering partners about what's possible and when.
  • Help your team use AI well — stay curious about tools like Figma AI, Claude, and Gemini and how they can help your designers work better: faster exploration, smarter prototyping, better research synthesis. You don't need to be an expert, but you're not slowing down experimentation either.
  • Contribute IC design work when the work calls for it — you're an experienced designer, and there are moments where the team needs your hands on a problem. Roll up your sleeves when it's the right call; delegate when it isn't.
  • Hire well — contribute to recruiting when the team has open roles. Use each hire to bring in diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and build the kind of team where different viewpoints make the work better.
  • Connect Hyderabad to the rest of the design org — bridge your team to design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain. Apply New Relic's design standards and practices locally, and make sure your team isn't working in isolation from the broader design org direction.

This role requires

  • 8+ years of product design experience, with meaningful time on technically complex B2B or enterprise software — products with data-dense interfaces, technical users, and real stakes in production
  • 2–4 years of direct people management — you've run 1:1s, given honest performance feedback, and developed designers at different career stages
  • Experience working across time zones — comfortable with async communication and able to build real working relationships with partners you won't always be in the same room as
  • A clear design point of view and the confidence to use it — you can evaluate work, give specific feedback, and hold a position with a PM or engineering partner who pushes back
  • Strong written and verbal communication in English — this is a distributed org and clear communication is how work stays connected across it
  • A portfolio showing your design process and how you reason through hard problems — not just finished screens, but how you think and what tradeoffs you made

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience with APM, log management, observability, or similar developer-facing infrastructure products
  • Familiarity with design systems and when to work within them vs. when to push on them
  • Experience hiring and growing a design team over time, not just managing a steady state

title: Software Engineer - ADM
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

Did you know? Alternative investing has the potential to generate higher returns compared to traditional investments over the long term. AI and Machine Learning are revolutionizing the way alternative investments are managed and analyzed. Investors are using these technologies to gain insights, see opportunities, and optimize their investment strategies. 

Addepar is building solutions to support our clients' alternatives investment strategies. The alternatives data management product is a serverless, modular and terraformed stack. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to design, implement and deliver modern software solutions that ingest and process ML-extracted data. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including data scientists and product managers to build intuitive solutions that revolutionize how clients experience alternatives operations.

You will work closely with operations engineering on document-based workflow automation and peer engineering teams to define the tech stack. You will iterate quickly through cycles of testing a new product offering on Addepar. If you've crafted scalable systems, or worked with phenomenal teams on hard problems in financial data, or are just interested in solving really hard technical, critically important problems, come join us!

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Architect, implement, and maintain engineering solutions to solve complex problems; write well-designed, testable code.
  • Lead individual project priorities, achievements, and software releases.
  • Collaborate with machine learning engineers to bring ML-extracted data into the backend stack of the application in Python or other languages.
  • Collaborate with product managers and client teams on product requirements iterations, design feasibility and user feedback.
  • Document software functionality, system design, and project plans; this includes clean, readable code with comments.
  • Learn and promote engineering standard methodologies and principles.

Who You Are

  • At least 3 years of Backend development experience
  • In-depth knowledge of Python or Java similar
  • Experience with NoSQL databases
  • Experience with serverless architecture
  • IaC (infrastructure as code), preferably terraform
  • Solutions-oriented, with exceptional analytical and problem solving skills
  • Experience with AWS is a strong plus.
  • Experience with DynamoDB, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch
  • Familiarity with writing, debugging, and optimizing SQL queries
  • Knowledge of front end development is a plus.
  • Experience in fintech (wealth/portfolio management domain) is a plus.

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: Platform Hiring Specialist (French-speaking)

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role

Ethos is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Platform team and build the internal infrastructure, services, and tooling that the rest of the company's data stack runs on. This is a software engineering role with a deep data background. You will design and operate distributed workflow systems on Temporal and Airflow, build internal platform applications (including config-driven UIs that let teams author and run their own ingestion and transformation jobs), and write Python libraries that other engineers across the company consume. You will also administer the data infrastructure we own, such as Snowflake, dbt Cloud, Airflow, and Kafka, with deep ownership of governance, reliability, and cost.

Your customers are other engineers, analytics engineers, data scientists, and operations teams. The platform you build is what makes their work possible. If you enjoy building developer-facing platforms, operating distributed systems in production, and going deep on the modern data stack, we'd like to talk to you.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Build and operate internal data platforms, services, and distributed workflow systems (Temporal, Airflow) that the rest of the company's data stack runs on.
  • Write and maintain internal Python libraries (including shared Airflow operators and frameworks) consumed by other engineering teams.
  • Build and operate Temporal-based workflow systems for long-running, reliable distributed data workflows.
  • Build internal data platform applications, including config-driven UIs that enable users to author and run their own ingestion and transformation jobs.
  • Own cost governance across Snowflake, dbt Cloud, Airflow, and Kafka and other data platform services, including monitoring, alerting, and optimization initiatives.
  • Administer Snowflake at depth: role hierarchy design, RBAC, data masking and row access policies, network policies, resource monitors, and cost governance.
  • Own production code end-to-end: design, review, deploy, operate, and respond to incidents.
  • Develop end-to-end automation for service and ML model deployment, ensuring smooth transition from development to production.
  • Implement tools and processes to monitor the performance, reliability, and health of production systems and ML models.
  • Support the Analytics Engineering function by building the platform capabilities (orchestration, CI/CD, testing frameworks, metadata) that data marts are built on.
  • Work closely with software engineering, analytics, operations, business and product teams, to understand and meet their platform and data requirements.
  • Ensure that all platform and data warehouse activities adhere to regulatory standards, data privacy rules, and company policies.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one programming language such as Go or Python.
  • Experience building and maintaining backend systems, internal tools, or platform applications in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and system design.
  • Strong understanding of software development best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, code review, and observability.
  • Proficiency in SQL and data modeling.
  • Strong understanding of ETL processes, data warehousing, and data governance principles.
  • Experience building and managing data-intensive or distributed applications.
  • Experience designing and operating APIs, services, and workflow-based systems.

Good to have

  • Experience with Go & Python in production environments.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration platforms such as Temporal.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or business-critical internal applications.
  • Experience with MLOps, including ML model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management. Familiarity with tools and platforms like MLflow, Kubeflow, or SageMaker.
  • Experience with Snowflake, Airflow, and dbt.
  • Experience with stream processing frameworks such as Flink.
  • Experience with cloud-native infrastructure and containerized deployments.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling for production systems.

#LI-Hybrid
#LI-KP1

 

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.

To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.

Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.

We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: AddeGrad Program (2027) - Client Solutions Analyst
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Program

Being a part of the AddeGrad Program, you will be working on meaningful projects that you can feel proud of while building your career for future advancement. In addition to having a supportive manager and collaborative teams, we provide an in-depth onboarding and enablement program to get you acclimated and ready for each path of your career growth journey in the program. A strong corporate culture and cool swag are also included!

This 18-month step program will provide exposure to key functions of the Client Services team and in-depth knowledge of the Addepar platform - integral to unlocking further career growth and development within the company. You’ll have the ability to partner with key stakeholders across our Go-To-Market and R&D teams. Upon completion of the program, you’ll be prepared to continue growing your career in other parts of the business, such as Client Success, or continue within Client Services. The start date for the program will be July 2027, and based from our SLC office.

Onboarding dates are currently set for the summer season, but please consult with your recruiter. Seeking US candidates only. Specific to US candidates, this program is being hosted out of our Salt Lake City location.

The Role

We are currently seeking a Client Solutions Analyst to join our Services Team! Client Solutions Analysts are responsible for designing and implementing Addepar for new clients. They are passionate about identifying how Addepar can unlock significant value for clients’ businesses and regularly call upon their analytical and consulting skills in order to advise clients on how to model and examine their financial instruments and assets. Client Solutions Analysts have a deep understanding of both finance and technology and take ownership of clients’ success.

Our ideal candidate has a strong desire to provide an outstanding client experience directly in investment management or in software deployments of a related domain; they are expected to display a strong sense of self-reliance as well as the ability to collaborate with other Addepar resources within our Sales, Product, and Partnership organizations. They must have a deep understanding of our target markets (or a hunger and willingness to learn). Ideal candidates are passionate about understanding our client's needs and taking a hands-on approach to solving problems.

In this role, you will lead the design and oversight for new clients onboarding to the Addepar platform, ensuring that we’re developing the best solutions to fit their unique and complex requirements. Additionally, you will be responsible for ensuring that the solutions we develop for our clients are compatible with the other products and services within the Addepar ecosystem as our offering continues to expand.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

You’ll be joining a post-graduate cohort, growing and developing your career in an 18-month program with direct exposure and access to our most valuable asset - our clients.

You will begin your journey on the Client Support team where you'll gain in-depth product knowledge as you become an Addepar platform expert working to:

  • Provide hands-on support to identify, respond to, and resolve issues and questions raised by Addepar’s clients
  • Work in complex data sets to identify and resolve data and calculation discrepancies
  • Collaborate with R&D teams to conduct root-cause analysis; Product and Account Management to manage and maintain client satisfaction.
  • Help clients use Addepar to the greatest extent through both functional and conceptual instruction

In future rotations, you’ll shift your focus towards other roles  within the Services organization to:

  • Learn how to design solutions and execute project implementations
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery and client satisfaction
  • Prioritize and context-switch effectively to support simultaneous projects
  • Identify and drive opportunities to improve our current processes and standard methodologies as the Addepar platform continues to rapidly expand
  • Connect with clients in a proactive, consultative, and professional manner
  • Effectively communicate project health and status to internal and external senior leadership.

Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for this role within the United States.

Compensation for this role includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Base Salary Range
$68,000—$68,000 USD

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. The Role

The ADM Support team handles all client inquiries related to Addepar's Alternatives Data Management (ADM) solution post-implementation. ADM Support Analysts play a critical role in supporting some of the world's most sophisticated investors, answering questions and resolving issues related to their alternative investment data on the Addepar platform. They ensure clients get the most value out of each interaction by providing accurate, timely guidance across the full scope of ADM functionality.

Our ideal candidate is tenacious about tackling problems, can skillfully coordinate with internal teams, and enjoys working directly with clients in the alternative investments space.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify, respond to, and resolve issues and questions raised by ADM clients, providing timely and accurate support.
  • Work in complex alternative investment data sets to identify and resolve data and calculation discrepancies.
  • Evaluate the criticality of client issues and collaborate with other internal ADM teams (Collections, Operations) to drive resolution.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis in partnership with Engineering and Data teams to resolve issues.
  • Help clients leverage the ADM platform to the greatest extent possible through both functional and conceptual instruction.
  • Prioritise and context-switch effectively to execute on simultaneous cases, seeing each through to the finish line.
  • Contribute to improving team processes and documentation as we scale and deliver on ADM.
  • Develop deep expertise in Addepar's ADM solution and the broader alternative investments landscape.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or equivalent experience.
  • 1+ years of relevant experience in a client-facing role, ideally within financial services or investment management.
  • Strong communication, organisational, and time-management skills.
  • Proficiency in maths and comfort working in complex data sets.
  • Passion for problem-solving and continuous learning.
  • Passion for technology and finance.
  • [Plus] Previous experience in investment management, particularly alternative investments.
  • [Plus] Familiarity with alternative investment data and its operational nuances.
  • [Plus] Experience using or supporting the Addepar platform.

Our Values

We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

title: Sr. Solution Consultant III
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

We are looking for a self-motivated Sr. SOLUTION CONSULTANT to join our Asia Presales team, to support our Philippines business- An excellent opportunity for candidates who are looking for regional exposure and willing to relocate to Philippines. 

A position with Anaplan’s presales team means being part of one of the fastest growing cloud vendors and making your mark on a changing industry. You get to meld your love of numbers with your love of sales and be rewarded for success with an outstanding commission structure in a fast moving, stimulating environment. As a Solution Consultant, you enjoy helping people solve hard problems. You are a bit savvy about cool products and you love showing people how those products can help their businesses.
You will join a team of individuals who embrace and respect diverse perspectives, aren’t afraid to push boundaries and try new insights, and are passionate about helping our customers and each other succeed. We work hard, but we also don’t wait for an excuse to have fun. In fact, we’re so serious about it that it’s one of our core values.

What you will be doing:

  • Engaging with targeted, large enterprise prospects to identify broken business processes and problems. Ascertaining and explaining Anaplan’s outstanding ability to solve them.
  • Developing planning function-specific solutions, demos, and messaging. Building Proof of Concept models that are tailored to solve prospects’ problems.
  • Navigating sophisticated prospect environments to facilitate the adoption of the Anaplan solution.
  • Cross-training teammates on solution expertise.
  • Creating product awareness in the marketplace.

More about you:

  • BS / BA / Finance  or equivalent. (Post Grad and Professional Qualifications a plus)
  • A background in financial planning / planning, budgeting & forecasting / financial operation planning / financial analysis
  • Experience with multi-dimensional modelling, business intelligence, or analytics
  • Prior experience in Enterprise Planning Management a plus
  • Aptitude for quickly ramping up on new technology
  • Excellent presentation, client relationship, and interpersonal skills- both internally and externally

Preferred skills and technical familiarity:

  • Growth mentality
  • You’re comfortable challenging old ways of doing things
  • Ability to take a consultative selling approach by listening to customer needs and shaping a shared vision for a solution

title: Data Engineer
description:
Who are we? 

Zeta Global is seeking a talented and versatile Data Engineer to join our Data Exchange team within our highly skilled development office in Copenhagen. This team plays a critical role in developing and deploying Zeta’s next-generation data science and engineering technology, collaborating closely with our global teams in the US, Europe, India and Philippines. The Copenhagen office boasts a dynamic and focused environment, comprising a core group of start-up veterans and approximately 30 highly skilled professionals. 

 

As a member of the Data Exchange team, you will contribute to the analysis, development, and maintenance of our complex data infrastructure, a sophisticated ecosystem of interconnected systems. This team tackles a continuous stream of challenging projects originating from across the organization, demanding a high degree of expertise and innovation. We are seeking candidates with a strong foundation in data engineering, data analysis, and software development principles, and a demonstrated interest in exploring the intersections between these disciplines. 

 

The Company 

Zeta Global is a data and AI-powered marketing technology company built on the foundation of a robust consumer data platform. With billions of proprietary data points and sophisticated machine learning algorithms, Zeta helps marketers unlock actionable insights into consumer behavior and preferences. The company's Zeta Marketing Platform harnesses this powerful combination of data and AI to create personalized customer experiences across the entire customer journey, ultimately driving significant growth for its clients. Through a commitment to innovation in data science, Zeta Global provides enterprises with the tools they need to build meaningful and profitable customer relationships. 

 

The position 

The ideal candidate for the Data Engineer position at Zeta Global Copenhagen is a highly motivated and analytical individual with a passion for understanding complex (software) systems. You are adept at using data to identify issues, formulate solutions, and develop robust data pipelines and software. You thrive in an environment that offers significant autonomy in planning and executing your work, yet you are also a strong collaborator, readily engaging with fellow developers and international product stakeholders. 

 

You will be involved in every stage of the development process, from initial brainstorming to ongoing maintenance, with a primary emphasis on analysis, prototyping, and development. Our development process is a dynamic blend of agile and rapid prototyping methodologies, designed to foster a culture of "flexibility under responsibility." We prioritize focused development time and believe in the power of collaborative problem-solving, encouraging team members to both seek and offer assistance readily. 

 

Your profile 

We welcome candidates with a solid background in data analysis or software development, seeking professionals with proven experience or recent graduates. Regardless of your background, a crucial element is your intellectual curiosity, self-motivation, and a demonstrable ability to translate real-world challenges into data models, ETL processes, algorithms, and ultimately, functional code. A strong interest in data engineering and/or the AdTech domain, along with its associated technologies, is highly desirable, as well as knowledge of object-oriented programming languages, particularly Scala. 

 

Minimum Qualifications: 

  • A strong academic background in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or related disciplines). 

  • Hands-on experience in designing, building, and maintaining scalable and reliable data pipelines. 

  • Proficiency in Python, Scala or other OOP languages for data engineering and processing tasks. 

  • Strong data analysis skills, including working with large datasets. 

  • Knowledge of distributed data processing for batch workloads. 

  • Solid understanding of database technologies. 

 

Desired Qualifications: 

  • 2-3 years of experience with Scala for data processing. 

  • Strong software engineering skills, including experience with CI/CD pipelines and best coding practices. 

  • Familiarity with data integrations and efficient data transfers. 

  • Knowledge of data modeling, data warehousing concepts, and query optimization techniques. 

  • Experience with distributed data processing using Apache Spark. 

  • Experience with Airflow for workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring data pipelines. 

  • Cloud expertise, particularly AWS, including services such as S3, Glue, Athena and EMR. 

 

You approach problems with an analytical mindset and a pragmatic approach to solution development. You are a creative thinker, capable of identifying opportunities and weaknesses in proposed solutions, and constructively contributing with your own ideas. You thrive in a dynamic environment, adept at juggling multiple projects and connecting them with underlying data. You recognize that exploring new facets of data often yields greater insights than fine-tuning algorithmic parameters. You are equally comfortable implementing and optimizing solutions, and you are eager to tackle new challenges. 

 

You are a proactive and independent worker, eager to understand and engage with the company's core problem space. You possess excellent English communication skills, enabling effective collaboration with management and colleagues across our international offices. You are adaptable and comfortable navigating a dynamic environment where priorities may shift, taking ownership of tasks and seeing them through to completion. 

 

What we offer 

Join our dynamic team, largely comprised of Masters and PhDs in fields like Physics, Math, and Computer Science, and play a key role in shaping the future of our technology. You will collaborate with highly skilled professionals in a stimulating environment that fosters both learning and individual initiative. While we are passionate about exploring cutting-edge technologies and algorithms, we maintain a practical approach to implementing solutions. 

We believe in empowering our employees with autonomy and flexibility. We offer flexible work arrangements, including adjustable office hours and the possibility of occasional remote work, provided commitments are consistently fulfilled. You will have the freedom to select your preferred operating system (Mac, Windows) and development tools, with the expectation of independent maintenance and troubleshooting. We encourage the introduction of new technologies, contingent upon demonstrating their value and gaining team buy-in. 

 

Our international presence provides ample opportunities for cross-departmental collaboration and potential career advancement in locations like Berlin, San Francisco or New York. This full-time position (37 hours per week) is based at our Copenhagen office, located at Bernstorffsgade 21. A competitive benefits package is provided, including lunch, telephone/internet, and health insurance. The ideal candidate will be available to start as soon as possible. 

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply via LinkedIn, submitting a cover letter along with their application. Interviews will be scheduled on a continuous basis. For any inquiries, please contact Christian Bjørnbak at cbjornbak@zetaglobal.com.

title: Senior IT Engineer
description:
About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role

As an IT Engineer, you'll lead the design and evolution of our cloud-first IT environment, building scalable, secure, and highly efficient systems that support the entire organization. You’ll partner closely with cross-functional teams to implement modern IT solutions, strengthen our security posture, and drive operational excellence through automation, AI-powered agents, workflow design, and thoughtful system integration. You’ll help identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive manual work, improve how our core platforms connect and operate, and serve as a technical bridge between IT and software engineering teams. We value proactive problem solving, technical leadership, an automation-first mindset, and a security-first approach, and you’ll play a key role in shaping our internal standards, integrations, and IT strategy.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and manage a fully cloud-based IT environment, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security across a range of SaaS platforms.
  • Design, build, and operate workflow automation across the IT landscape using platforms such as Okta, Serval, and related iPaaS tooling.
  • Build, maintain, and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of AI-powered agents and automations that streamline IT workflows, shift routine requests to self-service, and remain reliable, monitored, and auditable.
  • Engineer and manage integrations between core systems (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, HR/finance platforms, and engineering tooling) using REST APIs, webhooks, and SCIM.
  • Manage API integrations across IT systems, including authentication, security, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Partner closely with software engineering teams to align on shared services, developer tooling, integrations, and standards.
  • Build joiner-mover-leaver (JML) and birthright access automation, with appropriate guardrails and audit logging for SOX- and PII-scoped systems.
  • Analyze ticketing and operational data to identify repetitive tasks suitable for automation and prioritize opportunities for implementation.
  • Apply a security-first mindset to everything you build, following least-privilege principles and partnering with Security to keep automations compliant.
  • Develop and maintain clear documentation, runbooks, and integration standards so automations are maintainable and knowledge is not siloed.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT issues, conducting deep root cause analysis and implementing long-term solutions.

Qualifications and Skills: 

  • 5+ years of experience in IT engineering, systems administration, or a related role in a cloud-first environment.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and managing integrations across SaaS platforms using REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and SCIM.
  • Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code AI and automation tools and iPaaS platforms (e.g., Okta Workflows, Serval, Workato, Zapier, or equivalent).
  • Experience building or integrating AI agents and bots.
  • Experience managing Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and common device management tools such as Jamf and Intune.
  • Ability to work effectively with software engineering teams, with a solid understanding of version control (Git), CI/CD concepts, shared APIs, and services.
  • Security-first mindset, with familiarity applying least-privilege principles and supporting compliance frameworks such as SOX and SOC 2.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills, with the ability to design durable, long-term solutions.
  • Experience with Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) or modern network security approaches.
  • Strong communication skills, able to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders and across time zones.
  • Strong documentation skills.
  • Proofpoint experience is a plus.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on programming/scripting ability — Python and JavaScript preferred — for building integrations and automations.
  • Experience with AI orchestration or agent platforms (e.g. Serval, Forethought, or LLM-based tooling).
  • Exposure to standing up or scaling a global capability centre (GCC).

#LI-SP1
#LI-Hybrid

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.

To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.

title: Software Engineer - Java
description:
We are seeking a driven Java engineer to join our global research platform team in Mumbai. The team builds and operates the compute and data platform that powers all of IMC's quantitative research: a large-scale Kubernetes-based research cluster, a distributed job scheduling platform used by every trading and research team, and the market-data and dataset services that feed research on it. Mumbai runs one of the platform's regional production deployments, and you'll collaborate closely with platform colleagues in Amsterdam, Chicago and Sydney. 

 

Your Core Responsibilities: 

  • Design, build and operate the Java backend of our distributed job scheduling platform: the job controller and state machine, scheduling integrations, resource and cost tracking, and the failure-recovery machinery that keeps research workloads running at scale
  • Develop gRPC/protobuf APIs consumed by Python, Java and C++ clients across the firm
  • Build event-driven services on Kafka for job lifecycle tracking, data lineage, and dataset orchestration
  • Work hands-on with Kubernetes at scale: pod scheduling, fair-share queueing, preemption and multi-cluster placement
  • Instrument, monitor and firefight production systems, and drive root-cause analysis of performance bottlenecks
  • Support and consult research users in the India office

 

Your Skills and Experience: 

  • 3+ years of professional Java development experience (Java 17+, Maven/Gradle, strong grasp of concurrency and JVM performance)
  • 2+ year of hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker (building on the K8s API is a strong plus)
  • Comfortable developing in Python; our client libraries and research users are Python-first, and you'll work on both sides of the API
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems fundamentals: state machines, retries/idempotency, event-driven architectures, consistency trade-offs
  • Experience with workload scheduling or batch/compute orchestration systems (e.g. Kubernetes schedulers, Slurm, YARN, Kueue, Ray, Airflow)
  • Experience with messaging/streaming systems such as Kafka
  • Working knowledge of NoSQL and time-series/SQL databases (e.g. MongoDB, PostgreSQL)
  • Experience with gRPC/protobuf or similar RPC frameworks is a plus
  • Strong Linux fundamentals and scripting (bash, Python)
  • Experience with monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, alerting) and comfort operating what you build
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot across the stack from application code through Kubernetes to network and storage
  • Exposure to object storage (S3) or high-performance data formats (Parquet, Iceberg)

About Us

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

About WPP Media 

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com. 

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com 

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values: 

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. 
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. 
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. 

Role Summary and Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for an Associate Director Cross channel who will do:

  • Client & Channel Leadership Act as the lead and primary point of contact for key digital marketing channels—including Search, Social, Programmatic Buying Units (PBU), Ad Operations, or Commerce (all or couple of them). Represent the Global Operations Center (GOC) in all channels wise agency/market interactions, ensuring expectations are managed and consistently met. Serve as the custodian of activation excellence for assigned channels, driving trust and accountability across global stakeholders.
  • Campaign Activation & Performance Oversight Oversee the activation, and optimization of campaigns across multiple channels and designated markets. Ensure flawless execution that aligns with broader media strategies and brand objectives. Work in close partnership with local and regional teams to maintain consistency, enhance performance, and deliver measurable impact through detailed reporting and actionable insights.
  • Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership Build and maintain strong relationships with internal market teams (Europe, U.S., Asia, MEA, AUNZ), agency partners, and cross-functional groups. Act as a strategic advisor, offering data-driven solutions tailored to regional needs while upholding global standards. Partner with leadership and internal clients to drive innovation, resolve challenges, and influence strategic decisions that contribute to business growth.
  • Operational Excellence & Governance Design, implement, and manage scalable workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to enhance operational efficiency, campaign quality, and consistency. Enforce compliance with global taxonomy, quality assurance, and platform governance standards. Analyze operational data and feedback to identify improvement areas, ensure process adherence, and escalate issues to the appropriate stakeholders for resolution.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of subject matter experts responsible for campaign execution, optimization, and reporting. Foster a collaborative, accountable, and growth-oriented team culture. Ensure efficient team resourcing, continuous skills development, and alignment with organizational objectives through regular feedback, coaching, and performance evaluation.
  • Innovation, Automation & Business Growth Proactively identify new business opportunities within existing accounts and emerging markets. Collaborate with directors and senior leadership to develop compelling discussions for onboarding new scopes of work. Champion the adoption of internal and external automation tools and technology solutions to drive operational efficiency and future-proof activation capabilities.
  • Coordination with internal team to overall smooth running for operations.

 Skills and Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:

  • Graduation or Post Graduation Degree in Any stream
  • 8+ year's professional experience in digital media execution
  • You are an expert & executed on respective channel platforms
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheet
  • Working knowledge in HubSpot, Smartly, 4C, Scibids, or third-party tools like Dataroma, Google Studio is an added advantage
  • Experience managing multi-location media activation teams.
  • Experience training and maintaining quality standards at scale.
  • Experience providing service to local teams from a centralized location.
  • Passion for everything digital, with an active interest and understanding of online advertising industry trends.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Possess a solution-oriented mindset and analytical skillset.
  • Proactive, display exemplary leadership with a positive go-getter attitude.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. title: Internal Events Marketing Manager
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are looking for an Internal Events Manager to join our Field Marketing & Advocacy team. This role owns Addepar's internal event programming — including our Sales Kickoff (SKO), Accelerate, President's Club, and other company and sales-facing programs that bring our teams together, reinforce culture, and drive performance. You will also lead Addepar's webinar program end to end, from platform strategy and execution through performance reporting.

You will report to the Manager, Field Marketing and work closely with Sales, Account Management, Enablement, and Marketing to design programs that motivate our go-to-market teams, celebrate top performers, and keep our internal community informed and engaged. You'll also partner with Product Marketing and Demand Generation to run a webinar program that generates pipeline and supports customer engagement.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

Internal Events Management 

  • Own end-to-end planning and execution of Addepar's internal events, including Sales Kickoff (SKO), Accelerate, President's Club, and other recurring internal programs — from concept and budget through logistics, content coordination, and post-event follow-up.
  • Partner with Sales Leadership and Enablement teams to align each program's agenda, format, and structure with company priorities and sales motivations.
  • Manage vendors, venues, travel logistics, and on-site execution for internal programs, ensuring a seamless and memorable experience for attendees.
  • Build and manage budgets for internal event programs, tracking spend and reporting on ROI and attendee satisfaction.
  • Continuously evolve internal programming based on feedback and performance data to keep programs fresh, relevant, and high-impact.

Webinar Program Management 

  • Support Addepar's webinar program, managing the end-to-end logistical process from scheduling through platform execution, promotion, and post-webinar reporting.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, and Sales to build a webinar calendar that supports pipeline generation, product launches, and customer engagement goals.
  • Manage the On24 platform, including registration pages, event setup, integrations, and troubleshooting to ensure a smooth attendee experience.
  • Track and report on webinar performance (registrations, attendance, engagement, and pipeline influence), sharing insights with stakeholders to continually improve program performance.

  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for Sales and internal stakeholders on all things related to internal events and webinars.
  • Partner with the broader Field Marketing & Advocacy team to ensure internal programming and webinars are aligned with the overall events calendar and marketing strategy.
  • Maintain accurate records of leads, registrants, and event data within Salesforce, ensuring clean handoffs to Sales and accurate pipeline attribution.

  • 3-5 years of experience in event marketing, internal communications/events, or webinar program management, ideally within a B2B or SaaS environment.
  • Hands-on experience managing a webinar platform is required; proficiency with On24 specifically is strongly preferred.
  • Experience planning and executing large-scale internal programs (kickoffs, incentive trips, recognition events, or similar).
  • Familiarity with Salesforce and experience partnering closely with Sales teams.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple programs and stakeholders simultaneously, on time and on budget.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust and alignment across Sales, Marketing, and executive stakeholders.
  • A collaborative, detail-oriented, and adaptable approach, with comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically (and occasionally internationally) to support flagship internal events.

The role is responsible for delivering data analysis and establishing automated reporting, controls and monitoring for the BROKK team on both ad‑hoc and scheduled bases, leveraging a suite of analytical tools and SQL.   • Data/Business Analysis: Perform and document analysis, review and study of tariff, invoice and fee data; understand business changes, assess impact and cost. 
  • Data Visualization: Provide dashboards that present tariff usage, invoice acquisition status and fee‑taxonomy in an appealing, user‑friendly way. 
  • Data Mining: Extract patterns and knowledge from large volumes of data stored in the BROKK database (tariffs, providers) to answer investigations or control needs. 
  • Data Science: Apply scientific methods to relational data to automate processes & controls (e.g., automatic validation of rate‑card documents, auto‑acquisition of invoices).

  • Set up automated controls for document storage, tariff validation, invoice acquisition and accounting based on user requirements.

  • Manage workload – prioritize and organize tasks, recognize urgency and deliver on time. 
  • Analyze and solve problems – proactively identify missing rate cards, mismatched fee taxonomy or invoice gaps and implement solutions. 
  • Communicate clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences; deliver high‑quality presentations.

  • Quality‑focused with strong attention to detail.

  • True team player with creativity and a problem‑solving mindset. 

Specific Qualifications:

  • Advanced knowledge of SQL, with hands‑on experience in Oracle environments. 
  • Functional knowledge of financial products and regulatory frameworks (EMIR, MiFID, CFTC, …). 
  • Proficiency with visualization tools such as Microsoft Power BI or Oracle Apex.

About WPP Media 

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com. 

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. 
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. 
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. 

 

Some of the things we’d like you to do:

  • Lead Strategic Measurement & Testing: Propose and develop learning agendas and quarterly measurement plans
  • Orchestrate the setup, monitoring, and analysis of testing frameworks, including Conversion Lift Studies (CLS), Matched Market Testing (MMT), and Brand Lift Studies (BLS)
  • Deliver Actionable Insights & Storytelling: Create "Hero" and General CLS results into cohesive, compelling narratives that ladder up to broader business goals
  • Take ownership of end-to-end document creation and lead clint presentations with key stakeholders, including ML, MLMO, and PMM teams
  • Manage critical timelines for inflight optimisations, Datalink, and Post Campaign Analysis (PCA) creation
  • Oversee the maintenance of launch dashboards, daily budget tracking, and ensure strict alignment on ULS naming conventions and approved measurement solutions
  • Operational Excellence & Tooling: Troubleshoot implementation issues, (e.g., tactic-level optimization mapping and PA naming discrepancies)
  • Ensure pacing dashboards and quarterly budgets are accurately populated and maintained
  • Team Leadership & Cross-Capability Collaboration: Manage close working relationship and regular contact with wider Pixel team analysts ensuring your team delivers on-time, high-quality execution
  • You will build trusted relationships with activation, planning, and incrementality teams to integrate analytics seamlessly into the overall client strategy

.

A bit about yourself:

  • 6+ years of experience in a data & insight role, with practical expertise in digital campaign measurement for both Direct Response and Brand Awareness
  • Proven Leadership: 2+ years of management experience with a demonstrated ability to estimate project scope, resolve issues proactively, and foster morale within a team
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong capabilities in systems such as SQL, Python, or 'R', with the ability to troubleshoot platform coding issues and manage complex data inputs
  • Advanced Analytical Rigour: Deep understanding of structured experimentation (e.g., GLA, Turnkey tests, MMT, CLS) and how to map regional/postcode data to test designs

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. title: Senior Manager, Sales Operations

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Here at Anaplan, we have reinvented how companies see, plan, and run their businesses. Our platform allows our customers to uncover new insights, connect their strategy to their plans, and work in ways they had not previously thought possible. We’re growing fast, constantly innovating, and couldn’t be prouder to help our customers move forward with confidence in a sophisticated and changing world.

We are looking for forward-thinking people who put customer experience at the forefront of every decision. Individuals who thrive on challenges and are ready to grasp the opportunity of a lifetime. Because we fundamentally believe every colleague brings outstanding value to our whole. We are a workplace where each person feels seen, heard, and valued, and can contribute their unique talent to our collective effort. We believe that for ourselves and for our customers.

Anaplan is looking for a driven and dynamic Sales Operations Senior Manager to join our APAC Field Operations Organization. This is a critical role to drive the day-to-day operations for our India business. Think of this role as our Area Vice President’s “Right Hand person” and key business partner while also supporting the strategic initiatives of the Managing Director, APAC. The position will be based out of our Mumbai office and report to the Senior Director of APAC Sales Operations.

In This Role, You Will Utilize:

  • Your analytics skills to diagnose issues and prescribe the help the sales team needs
  • Your strategic thinking on where the best opportunities are and how to resource against them in the form of territories and account assignments
  • Your operator mindset to help the team execute at the highest possible level
  • Your leadership and facilitation skills to support the team's Rhythm of Business processes (e.g., weekly forecast calls, pipeline reviews, Quarterly Reviews)
  • Your technical expertise to root cause anomalies or challenges in the business to course correct, improve processes, and drive operational alignment
  • Your empathy and ability to connect with sales leaders, account executives, and other GTM leaders to help them achieve big and bold objectives

Ideally, you have helped scale a hypergrowth business past $1B in revenue. You are a detail-oriented operator who is passionate about both the art and science of sales. You know how to define a champion, you get why adoption matters in SaaS, and you take pride in helping your sales team deliver high quality deals that translate into strong customer engagements. Most importantly, you have strong opinions on the best way to engage with and motivate a sales team, and you will thrive in an entrepreneurial environment that will give you a unique opportunity to prove your ideas out.
