title: Business Development Representative - Spanish or Portuguese Speaking
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

Preferred location is NYC; will consider remote for dual language speakers (Spanish, Portuguese)

Addepar is looking for a high-energy, results-driven Business Development Representative to join our Business Development & Sales organization. Working very closely with Sales and key partners, BDRs are tasked with strategically developing and qualifying revenue opportunities within assigned account territories and segments. This is an exciting opportunity to generate and hunt for new business opportunities to fuel our growth across the wealth management, family office, private banking, and global investment management market segments. The ideal candidate will be passionate about finance and disruptive technology; have a sound eye for business and natural sales instincts; and be an eager, highly motivated, and tenacious self-starter.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

  • Generate new business opportunities to fuel Addepar’s growth
  • Create and prioritize strategic target account lists and account attack plans within a defined territory
  • Research and build new accounts (i.e. strategic calling, sending personalized emails, and connecting through social media platforms)
  • Conduct high level discovery conversations and meetings with prospect accounts. 
  • Collaborate with Go To Market teams (i.e. marketing, sales, and product, etc) to advance new business growth.
  • Achieve quarterly quotas of qualified opportunities created

Who You Are

  • 2-3 years of experience in outbound SaaS prospecting roles with proven track record of success (Fintech or financial services experience a plus!)
  • Knowledge of private banking, wealth management prospecting a plus
  • Strong work ethic, energetic, proactive, team player! 
  • Excellent problem solving, communication, organization and time management skills
  • Flexibility and ability to adapt to new demands; strong sense of urgency
  • Assertiveness, directness, and a “company first” mentality
  • Experience working with Salesforce, Gong, and Salesloft is a plus

Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for this role within the United States.

Compensation for this role includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Base Salary Range
$75,000—$105,000 USD

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Senior Analyst, Analytics and Insights (Programmatic)
description:
Senior Analyst, Analytics and Insights (Programmatic)

About the role:

The Programmatic Analytics and Strategy team at Zeta Global provide actionable insights to both external customers and internal teams. For external customers, analysts partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to monitor our optimization platform, design Real-time Brand Optimization surveys, introduce humanly designed segments to boost model exploration and learning, and deliver actionable insight presentations and lead marketing strategy discussions with clients. For internal teams, they provide feedback to our Product and Engineering teams on automation and model features to advance the reliability, reach, and effectiveness of programmatic campaigns.


Responsibilities:

  • Client-facing lead responsible for communication campaign strategy, reviewing campaign-based insights and providing a story-telling interpretation to provided insights
  • Work with clients to understand key business challenges and design analytic and testing plans to derive actionable intelligence.
  • Own campaign performance and reporting insights while recommending opportunities for optimization (ex. running additional channels, updating current targeting strategy, pitching new analyses to help with client’s business challenges/objectives).
  • Reviewing performance of models across revenue, performance, and pacing.
  • Design and implement tests to evaluate model and feature performance.
  • Working with internal teams and stakeholders to determine measurement tools and products are appropriate for addressing client business challenges.
  • Develop innovative measurement tools and solutions
  • Consult with clients regarding development & alignment of marketing programs across on-line channels.
  • Determine set-up, including testing methodologies, reporting requirements, and optimization modeling requirements, for ensuring full impact and efficiency of optimization efforts. Part of internal team discussions to help set up campaigns for success.
  • Communicate campaign optimization results to clients to prove value against original business goals.

 

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • 2+ years of working experience in a similar role.
  • Extensive experience with SQL and Excel/pivot tables.
  • Experience in a digital media/Programmatic analytics role
  • Experience puling & putting together audience insights reports
  • Experience with VBA/Excel Macros, Tableau, Python, SAS or other data manipulation tools a plus.
  • A great communicator who is able to convey complex technical features in simple terms.
  • Someone with an aptitude for media and strategy and able to contextually relay concepts to clients.
  • Able to multitask and prioritize among several high-profile clients.
  • Have a high degree of creativity, attention to detail, self-motivation, and drive.
  • Eagerness to work in a startup team environment that will be rapidly changing
  • Enthusiastic team player with a penchant for collaboration and knowledge sharing.
  • Willingness to do whatever it takes to get the job done.
  • Nerdy but loveable.

  • Establish clear data-sharing protocols and audit mechanisms with external technology partners.

  • Lead cross-functional alignment across Legal, InfoSec, Compliance, and Commercial teams to establish streamlined, institutional-grade risk assessment and deal-structuring workflows.

  • Work with key stakeholders to design, scale and support partner onboarding pathways, including collaborating to build out self-serve developer portals, robust sandbox environments, standardized API/SDK documentation, and client onboarding partner platform.

  • Partner Velocity & Onboarding Efficiency: Decreased cycle time from partner execution to live, active platform integration.

title: Data Validation-Liquidity
description:
Job title: Data Validation

 

Role Purpose (overall high level summary of the role)

Finance has mobilised the first phase of a five year programme to transform the Finance operating model by leveraging

cloud technology. Finance Cloud Transformation will rationalise operational processes, automate data and report

production, to deliver comprehensive data to our internal and external stakeholders for analysis and reporting. The

programme will entail migration of core Finance data and processes to the cloud, with an initial phase to implement a

standard global operating process for Finance actuals report production, followed closely by forecast data and report

production. The vision for the Finance on the Cloud Programme is “to deliver standardised global processes that leverage

a single dataset for reporting, analysis and forecasting.” Key programme outcomes are to deliver a singular automated

data production processing capability for actuals and forecasting, correction of data once for all downstream calculations,

reports and outputs, introducing automated preventative and detective controls, significantly reduce manual activity in the

run-time actuals process to allow the production of all actuals outputs by working day 5 for a monthly process The Data

Analyst will be expected to support the delivery of data related activities within the FotC programme. Various aspects may

include data validation, solution functionality validation, data gap analysis, reconciliation, user tooling or automation

testing activities.

 

• The role holder will be responsible to functionally understand and test our liquidity core release requirements

• He/ She is required to perform a detailed data validation to ensure the data reflects accurately across all liquidity returns

for all applicable regulations - PRA/EBA/HKMA/US FED etc.

• He/She needs to furnish UAT dashboards and walkthrough the Reporting Ops of the changes introduced by liquidity

core release requirements

• He/She is responsible to handle various queries raised by Reporting Ops and drive the UAT sign off discussions for a

successful liquidity release implementation

 

 

Key accountabilities include:

· Review Finance wide manual adjustments and EUC’s including recommending automated solutions in order to

minimise operational risk and time

· Presenting Validation dashboards to relevant stakeholders and provide status update on their data accuracy and

completeness

· Gather requirements from business users on data validations, reconciliations and data elements

· Supporting FotC Data Lead in planning and tracking progress of data work stream

· Supporting wider Finance data related initiatives, including resolution of upstream data initiatives, investigation and

prioritisation of data issues, liaising with IT teams to support delivery of data sourcing changes

· Working with DMU to resolve Global Data Quality issues and creating a Data Operating Model

· Provide worldwide sites with effective communication of data issues in order for them to improve their data quality

· Work closely with diverse Business and IT teams, to ensure test issues and defects are successfully resolved Be

conversant with the principles of Finance data production and reporting, and understand the functions of relevant

Business stakeholder areas

· Facilitate issue resolution to ensure that the schedule of each work stream remains on track and that any issues are

resolved through appropriate, agreed solutions

· Perform Data Gap analysis and raise data sourcing requirements to relevant teams

· Work with dynamic plans in a fast moving environment, continually assessing priorities and progress and adjusting

course where necessary, being sure to maintain alignment with other programme work streams

· Support the internal and external audit where required. Ensure the relevant controls are met.

 

 

Technical Skill Requirements

 

· Exposure to Liquidity Risk reports – PRA LCR, PRA NSFR PRA110 and ILM

· Able to understand regulations on liquidity risk and write requirements required for remediating adjustments

· An understanding of the principles of Finance data and report

· Proficient in interrogating databases via SQL queries

· An understanding of systems delivery lifecycles and testing principles

· Proficient in the use of test tools (such as Quality Centre) and test processes (e.g. defect management)

· Be able to formulate test strategies and confident in running a successful test phase

· An appreciation of systems and data architectures

· Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, Project)

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) – Clinical Intelligence
description:
Truveta is the world’s first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta’ s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values. 

Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest in the USA and has employees who live across the country. As we expand our global footprint with a new presence in Hyderabad, India, we’re building a world-class team to help us scale this mission and Clinical Intelligence and AI Evaluation is at the heart of everything we do. This job requires daily onsite work at our headquarters in Hyderabad, India. 

This Opportunity 

Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center (IDC) and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the initial members, you'll help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is a unique opportunity to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub. This highly visible position will report to our Director of Clinical Intelligence and AI Evaluation team directly and will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and ML teams across geographies.  

Who We Need  

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex healthcare domain data and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you. 

This role is ideal for an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer who can design and deliver our critical internal annotation and administrative platforms to enable high-quality data modelling, clinical note annotation and normalization, LLM-based labelling, concept mapping, operational workflows and model evaluation frameworks across the company. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex full stack, i.e., UX, front end, backend and data problems and want to build tools used daily by internal clinical domain and technical experts. 

You will work closely with product managers, architects, security teams, and other engineers to build services that power Truveta’s healthcare data platform. As a senior engineer, you will also help shape technical direction, drive engineering best practices, mentor other engineers, and contribute to the long-term reliability, scalability, and maintainability of Truveta’s services. 

Responsibilities 

  • Lead the design, build, and maintain full-stack features for clinical data annotation and internal tooling platforms. 
  • Partner with product managers, architects, security teams, and other engineers to define and deliver reliable platform capabilities.  
  • Make sound technical decisions that balance scalability, performance, security, reliability, and delivery speed.  
  • Participate in and lead design reviews, architecture discussions, code reviews, debugging, on-call rotation and production issue resolution.  
  • Implement advanced UI interactions such as text highlighting, tagging, categorization, and review workflows.  
  • Build backend services that support high-quality data modelling, clinical note annotation and normalization, LLM-based labelling, concept mapping, operational workflows and model evaluation frameworks.  
  • Collaborate with ML engineers to translate annotation requirements into scalable solutions for LLM based model development and improve model performance. 
  • Optimize UX performance for high-volume data and concurrent users.  
  • Mentor engineers, provide technical guidance, and help improve team practices.  
  • Communicate on the status of various projects and collaborate with multidisciplinary stakeholders to ensure that clinical data projects are successfully executed and delivered. 

Required Skills 

  • Graduate or Masters level educational degree in computer science, data science, clinical informatics, health information management, clinical research, data analysis or related fields.  
  • 5+ years of demonstrated professional software development experience, including, 
  • Hands-on programming experience with C# and .Net/.Net Core, 
  • Front end development experience with React and TypeScript,  
  • State management frameworks such as Redux,  
  • Backend experience using NestJS (Node.js) and/or C#/.NET 
  • Familiarity with RESTful API design and modern service architectures.  
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, data structures, at least one statistical programming language (R or Python), familiar with Spark bigdata analytics environments, GenAI tools, for data wrangling, analysis, and reproducible research workflows. 
  • Strong understanding of software engineering practices including unit testing, code reviews, debugging, source control, CI/CD, and production service ownership.  
  • Solid understanding of security concepts such as authentication, authorization, secrets management, secure API design, and data protection.  
  • working with customers or research teams to translate their asks into executable analytical code, rigorous quality analytical datasets, deliver high quality research analyses.  
  • Strong hands-on problem-solving skills, troubleshoot and identify data or methodological issues early and communicate them effectively. Have ownership, accountability and reliability mindset. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain analytical approaches and findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to learn and adapt quickly in a dynamic start-up environment and a good team-player. 
  • Willingness to learn new analytical tools, programming languages, and proprietary platforms used to analyze real-world data. 

Preferred Qualifications 

These qualifications are preferred but not required, please do not let them stop you from applying for this role. You will likely get the opportunity to learn how to do these more advanced analyses if you don’t already have experience with them.  

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services.  
  • Experience building scalable services using ASP.NET Core, Web API, or similar frameworks.  
  • Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, queues, messaging, or data pipelines.  
  • Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark.  
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized application deployment.  
  • Experience with observability tools and practices, including logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and service health monitoring.  
  • Experience improving service reliability, performance, scalability, and operational excellence.  
  • Experience working with healthcare, data platforms, analytics platforms, or regulated environments.  
  • Interest in building reliable software that improves healthcare outcomes and helps save lives with data.  
  • Experience working with unstructured clinical data or natural language processing outputs 
  • conducting analyses using large healthcare datasets (e.g., electronic health records, clinical notes or other real-world data sources consisting of millions of patients' data.) optimized to handle large volumes of text, structured and unstructured data and complex review workflows. 

Why Truveta?  

Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional and everything in between. We are expanding our global footprint. Join us as we build an amazing company together. 

Truveta is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and empowering workplace. We believe that having employees, interns, and contractors with diverse backgrounds enables Truveta to better meet our mission and serve patients and health communities around the world. We recognize that opportunities in technology historically excluded and continue to disproportionately exclude people from some sections, people of color, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people. We strongly encourage individuals with these identities to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements.

title: Operations Trader
description:
We're looking for an Operations Trader to join our Index Options desk. This role sits at the intersection of trading, production operations, and technology — executing and monitoring index options strategies in real time, owning the day-to-day health of the book, and digging into execution quality and system behavior when things don't go as expected. We're especially interested in people who have owned the day-to-day of their own strategies before, even if that ownership wasn't the headline of their last role. 

 

Your Core Responsibilities: 

Trade Execution & Risk Monitoring

  • Execute and monitor index options strategies (Nifty, Bank Nifty) in real time, keeping algo activity within risk and margin limits.
  • Manage contract rolls — transitioning positions from back-month to front-month strategies — and maintain the automation that supports this.
  • Perform post-trade analysis on fills, market share, and execution quality.
  • Apply rigorous statistical methods to ensure the robustness and reliability of results

Production & Operational Ownership

  • Own reconciliation, network connectivity checks, and other production-health tasks that keep the desk running, even when they're not the most visible part of the job.
  • Investigate execution issues end-to-end — tracing latency and timelines of how information moves between internal systems and the exchange
  • Comfortable moving between well-defined, implementation-style tasks and open-ended investigations where the question itself needs to be framed.

 Automation & Tooling

  • Build and maintain automation in Python and Bash to reduce manual intervention and operational risk — e.g., auto-liquidation workflows, contract-roll automation, monitoring scripts.

Collaboration & Market Awareness

  • Build a deep understanding of market behaviour, pricing dynamics, and structural inefficiencies
  • Partner with Quant Researchers, Developers, Risk, and Operations to troubleshoot production issues and improve execution reliability — and bring genuine curiosity about how these workflows scale in a larger team.
  • Communicate clearly and in a structured way — able to explain technical or operational issues to both trading and non-trading stakeholders.
  • Mentor and train junior team members on desk processes and tools as the team grows.

 

Your Skills and Experience: 

  • Prior experience in trading operations, execution, or production support at a proprietary trading firm, market maker, or similar high-frequency environment
  • Strong foundation in probability, statistics, and quantitative modelling
  • Experience working with large datasets and time-series data
  • Strong programming skills in at least one language, preferably Python
  • Curious and analytical mindset, with a focus on problem-solving and innovation
  • Demonstrated ownership of production/operational tasks — reconciliation, connectivity, monitoring — beyond what's typically listed on a resume.
  • Experience investigating execution or system performance (latency analysis, timeline tracing across systems) is a strong plus.
  • No prior options experience required — but genuine initiative to learn (e.g., familiarity with options greeks, dynamic hedging, or having worked through texts like Natenberg) is a strong signal.
  • Comfortable operating under pressure during live market hours, including trading halts and reconciliations.
  • Strong communicator who structures ideas clearly and engages well in technical discussions.
  • Proactive mindset — someone who automates away recurring issues rather than just resolving them each time.
  • Track record of building automation that reduced manual or operational risk (e.g., auto-liquidation, contract-roll workflows).
  • Exposure to Indian equity/index derivatives market microstructure.
  • Experience mentoring or training junior team members.

About Us

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

Technical

title: Staff Product Analyst, Consumer
description:
About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the Role

This is a high-impact role for an analyst who wants to own the data behind a core part of our Consumer business and use it to change what gets built. You'll partner directly with product, design, and engineering to drive how we grow the direct-to-consumer funnel — from the moment someone lands on the site, through quote and approval, to activating their policy.

It starts with a real understanding of our customers, our funnel, and the levers that move conversion and retention. That understanding is what makes your analysis worth acting on. You use it to find the highest-leverage questions, spot opportunities the team hasn't seen yet, and bring recommendations that change roadmap decisions rather than just describe what happened.

The AI infrastructure we've built changes what this role looks like day to day. Mechanical analysis is faster than it has ever been, which frees you to spend your time on the parts that need judgment: framing the right question, validating what the tools produce, and drawing the conclusion the business should act on. We're further along on this than most companies, and we're still writing the playbook — you'll help shape it.

You go deep in analytics and experimentation on your product area, and AI gives you the reach to cover more ground than a traditional analyst.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Own the analytics for your product area. You partner with PMs across the Consumer funnel — landing page, quote flow, onboarding, approval, and activation — to define success metrics, find where users drop off, and make sure decisions are grounded in data. PMs make different calls because you're in the room.
  • Be accountable for outcomes, not output. You're measured on the business impact of the decisions your analysis influences — conversion, approval rate, activation, retention — not the number of analyses you produce. You connect findings across experiments and cohorts to surface patterns a single analysis would miss.
  • Own experimentation for your area. Design, instrument, and interpret A/B and multivariate tests — from CTA and quote-flow changes to eligibility and onboarding — with the statistical rigor to separate real lift from noise, and help raise the quality and speed of how the team runs experiments.
  • Build deep customer and funnel understanding. Develop a rich picture of how different segments behave — return visitors, demographic cohorts, traffic sources — and turn it into product recommendations that improve conversion for each group.
  • Own the quality of AI-assisted analysis. Our tools pull data, read configs, and draft analysis. You use them to move faster, and you own validating and sharpening what they produce. Human judgment over AI output, always.
  • Make insights self-serve. Build dashboards and frameworks that let PMs and leaders answer their own questions, and communicate findings in clear narratives that drive alignment and action, including with senior stakeholders.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 7+ years in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with real impact in high-growth, consumer-facing environments.
  • A track record of changing what a product team built or prioritized — not just reporting on what shipped.
  • You don't wait for a fully specified ask. You see the gap, frame the question, build the answer, and land it with the right audience.
  • Expert SQL, and fluency with a modern analytics stack — Snowflake and a product analytics tool like Amplitude. Python (or R) and dbt are a plus.
  • Deep experience designing and interpreting experiments and applying statistical rigor — regression, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing.
  • Daily use of AI tools in your analytics workflow, with a clear-eyed sense of where they accelerate the work, where they get it wrong, and where your own judgment is non-negotiable.
  • Strong communication and storytelling — able to turn complex analysis into clear, strategic narratives for PMs, engineers, and executives.

title: Director of CAD & IT
description:
CspeedIO is a stealth startup backed by Sutter Hill Ventures and Atreides Capital - headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.  Our executive team has a demonstrated track record of building and scaling category-defining semiconductor and infrastructure businesses at companies like Broadcom, Lumentum, Tesla, Apple, Samsung, Intel, and VMware.

CspeedIO is developing next-generation optical semiconductor solutions for the AI infrastructure market, focused on enabling true “scale-up” architectures.  Our mission is to replace traditional copper interconnects with advanced fiber-optic technologies that overcome the limitations of existing optics solutions and architectures.

The Role

A build role spanning three intertwined domains: design infrastructure (the CAD, compute, and EDA environment our silicon depends on), corporate IT (identity, endpoints, connectivity, and SaaS globally, and the security program that spans both. You will operate an EDA environment, a three-zone infrastructure model (Corporate, Design/CAD, Lab/OT) governed by export-control classification. CAD and IT carry equal weight, and security is required within both. And we expect aggression on AI: this role drives aggressive AI use and adoption across the company rather than waiting to be asked.

What You Will Own

  • Design infrastructure & CAD. Design compute (batch scheduling, cloud burst), EDA licensing operations — license servers, utilization telemetry, denial-rate and cost-per-seat reporting; contract and IP negotiation stays with company leadership — the access-controlled PDK enclave, design data management, and storage engineered for EDA workloads.
  • Corporate IT. Identity as a system (single IdP, SAML/SCIM, conditional access, hardware-key MFA), the global Windows/macOS/Linux endpoint fleet under unified MDM, WAN globally, the SaaS portfolio and its spend, and the MSP managed against an SLA you write.
  • Security across both zones. EDR on every host including Linux design machines; the outsourced security stack — SOC/MDR partner and SIEM — where you own the outcome and they own the night shift; phishing-resistant MFA; incident response end to end across time zones; segmentation between zones; customer security reviews answered unaided.
  • Export-controlled environments. Operate the design zone under our Technology Control Plan: deemed-export access controls with per-nationality entitlements, logging, quarterly access reviews, and audit-ready evidence.
  • AI adoption. Drive aggressive AI use across engineering and corporate workflows — pick the tools, build the guardrails that make AI safe inside an export-controlled environment, and lead by using it yourself. The job is to make yes safe, not to say no.

Must Have

  • CAD: 10+ years in semiconductor design infrastructure at a fabless or IDM; ran design compute, EDA licensing operations, and PDK/design-data management; supported tape-outs under deadline.
  • IT: ran identity as a system (SAML/SCIM, conditional access, hardware keys); managed a multi-country Windows/macOS/Linux fleet; managed an MSP against an SLA they wrote; completed customer security questionnaires unaided.
  • Security: operated EDR across mixed Windows/Linux fleets; personally owned a real incident end to end; ran security through outsourced SOC/MDR and SIEM vendors and owned the detection outcome anyway; built access-controlled environments for sensitive IP.
  • Across all of it: built from near-zero at least once; an aggressive, hands-on adopter of AI in their own work; effective across Asia time zones with a small team plus vendors; translates technical risk into executive decisions; a U.S. person or eligible for required export authorizations.

What This Role Is Not

Not a caretaker role, not a single-discipline role, not the EDA contract owner, and not paper security — this role runs the controls, it does not just document them.

Preferred: TCP/deemed-export operating experience; Defender, Intune, and Entra conditional access in production; FreeIPA in Linux design environments; ISO 27001, SOC 2, or NIST 800-171 exposure.

This role owns two connected functions: the bot building team (led day-to-day by a build Lead who designs ERDs and manages hands-on development) and the bot monitoring team (with functions including bot functionality audits, bug handling, quality control, and support). You'll manage and scale both, while remaining hands-on enough to personally evaluate bot builds against spec and catch issues before they reach customers.

The what and how of the roadmap are owned by our CX AI Product Manager, who sets priorities and writes the PRDs. Your job is to make sure what gets built actually matches that spec, to define how we test and monitor bots on an ongoing basis, and to make sure quality issues make it back into the roadmap fast. title: Senior Associate Workforce Planning
description:
About the Role

Support Operations is one of our core operations teams, responsible for making sure that when things go wrong, there's always someone there to make it right. The team designs, manages, and operates a large and growing global network of support centers, with the goal of delivering a world-class customer experience every time.

We're looking for an experienced Workforce Planner to help develop and scale our support lines of business. This role is central to planning monthly, daily, and hourly staffing levels, and to keeping hiring plans current so we consistently deliver best-in-class service. You'll play a key part in improving forecast accuracy, reporting, and how we plan around floor staff utilization and efficiency — for a 24/7/365 organization, wherever it operates.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

Capacity planning

  • Build and maintain support capacity plan models at the monthly, weekly, and interval level, using a quantitative model to determine the staff required to service forecasted volumes
  • Match staffing supply to required staff to ensure efficient service level attainment, and make hiring, ramp, and staff-reduction recommendations
  • Keep capacity plans and assumptions accurate, current, and aligned to source-of-truth headcount data, auditing regularly for accuracy
  • Ensure alignment from the smallest site/team level of detail up through the broader org-wide capacity plan
  • Maintain documentation of planning methodology, assumptions, and processes, and continually improve the planning tools, models, and templates themselves

Forecasting & scenario planning

  • Forecast incoming contact volume using historical and benchmark data, tracking deviations between forecast and actuals on a regular cadence
  • Build, update, and present "what-if" scenarios to evaluate potential changes and support upcoming initiatives, as well as annual, half-year, and quarterly planning scenarios for long-range and financial planning
  • Build and validate capacity models for new lines of business, queues, or markets, and identify overtime activation needs while ensuring compliance with local labor regulations in each region you support
  • Build out and report on seasonality trends for a complex, growing organization

Performance & insights

  • Dig into historical data to surface insights that improve support operations, speed, quality, and customer experience
  • Monitor service level performance, perform SL-miss analysis, and feed those insights back into planning

Staffing & headcount

  • Guide short-term staffing adjustments to close current gaps, and partner with Operations to track how staffing is implemented and optimized, driving proactive and corrective improvements
  • Reconcile planned vs. actual headcount and budget with Finance/HR, monitor the hiring pipeline against plan, and track new-hire ramp against expected productivity curves
  • Maintain a risk register or contingency plan for capacity gaps such as surges, outages, or attrition spikes, and incorporate attrition, absenteeism, and other shrinkage assumptions into the model

Cross-functional partnership

  • Partner with Real Time Analysts for demand insight and outage reporting
  • Partner with teams across operations, customer experience, product, engineering, and tools to improve processes and the resulting experience for customers and partners
  • Hold regular capacity plan reviews with leadership, and flag service level risks — with supporting analysis and a recommended mitigation plan — for upcoming projects and initiatives
  • Own your recommendations end-to-end: dig into the data, build the model, set implementation timelines, align partners, test ideas, and measure results

We're excited about you because…

  • You're analytical and data-driven — you love getting into the weeds, and you let data win arguments
  • You enjoy tackling complex problems and building something that hasn't existed before
  • You're well-organized and detail-oriented, with excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • You follow up and follow through — you execute and get the job done
  • You're comfortable in a fast-paced, constantly changing, team-oriented environment, and can manage multiple deadlines at once
  • You have an owner mentality: quality-focused, output-driven, proactive, and always pushing yourself to do better
  • You bring creative solutions to big challenges
  • You're comfortable operating at the lowest level of detail while also thinking long-term and inspiring a team
  • You're energized by rapid change and constant learning
  • You're comfortable pulling data or modeling in Excel/Google Sheets
  • You don't give up — if your first plan doesn't work, you have a few more in your back pocket
  • You have 4-6 years of relevant experience, having succeeded in diverse environments (tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or similar)
  • You have a Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • You bring hands-on experience with workforce management software (e.g., NICE, Verint, Genesys, or Aspect) and advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; SQL experience is a plus

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Manager, Workforce Planning
description:
About the Team

Our Workforce Management team's primary focus is to ensure we have the right people in the right place at the right time, so customers, merchants, and delivery partners get help as quickly and reliably as possible. The team brings a people-first mindset paired with strategy and operations to achieve its goals, moving quickly, applying first-principles thinking, and focusing on problem-solving to ensure seamless execution. The team manages workforce capacity planning, scheduling, and real-time operations for a large and growing global network of in-house and outsourced support centers, with the goal of delivering an outstanding customer experience reliably, at scale.

About the Role

As a Manager, Workforce Planning, you will lead a team of Workforce Planners, Schedulers, and Real Time Analysts (typically 5-7 direct reports), owning workforce planning and performance across an integrated scope that spans in-house and outsourced/vendor sites. You'll set direction for your team, own KPI performance, and partner cross-functionally to keep staffing supply aligned with business priorities.

This role flexes across two tracks depending on team needs and where your strengths lie: an Audience-facing track, where you act as the primary bridge between a specific line of business and the Workforce Management function, translating business goals into capacity plans and performance reporting; and a Technical track, where you directly supervise the team of planners who build the forecasts and schedules for all in-house and outsourced sites, focusing on the technical accuracy of capacity models and the tools behind them. Both tracks require a leader who can navigate ambiguity, identify root causes through data, and manage up and across with clarity and confidence.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Manage and develop a team of Workforce Planners, Schedulers, and Real Time Analysts (typically 5-7 direct reports), setting clear priorities and holding the team accountable to results
  • Own capacity plans and scheduling coverage across an integrated scope spanning in-house and outsourced/vendor sites
  • Own KPI performance — service level, occupancy, over/under staffing, and quality — and lead root-cause analysis and recovery planning when performance slips
  • Anticipate staffing risks and deviations before they affect service, and put proactive mitigation plans in place
  • Lead goal-setting for your area and track progress, translating results into clear updates for leadership
  • Partner cross-functionally to align staffing supply with evolving business priorities, and drive process and efficiency improvements

title: Liquidity reporting Compliance
description:
This role sits as part of a first line compliance function to ensure that functionality, processes and reporting outputs built for Reporting Ops meet the regulatory criteria as documented by the relevant regulatory instructions, regulations and policies. This role will involve close liaison with both Finance Change colleagues as well as colleagues in Reporting Operations interacting with the Reporting Owner for the Liquidity Regulatory Reports.

Role Profile and Description of Responsibility

Build and lead a BAU compliance function to ensure that the Regulatory Reporting functionality built and released quarterly under various change epics delivered by Finance Change comply with the reporting requirements as detailed under the Reporting Instructions and Reporting Regulations from the local or group regulator, as well as any additional Policy Interpretations provided by Group Reg. Policy or local policy representatives.

The role will involve close liaison with the Product Owner for Liquidity Reporting in identifying the epics delivered in the previous release to be tested for compliance; documenting the test cases required for compliance testing by reference to required instructions, regulations and policy; managing test execution by a small team of dedicated testers; analyse test results for compliance with the testers; flag any items which require further investigation; identify any cases of non-compliance back to stakeholders including Reporting Ops and Report Owners; provide rapid feedback to the build team in cases of re-build required for compliance.

Required Skill Set

Deep subject matter knowledge and expertise in liquidity reporting constructs (for example LCR, NSFR, Maturity Ladders, etc).

Knowledge of core regulatory requirements including reporting instructions, regulations (for example CRR), and internal policies for liquidity reporting

Documentation capability to document test cases for testing whether delivered build output complies with reg & policy requirements (including but not limited to the logic, filter criteria, data attributes, frequency requirements, static reference data requirements)

Able to work at pace to ensure that quarterly cadence of delivery of change in liquidity reporting is maintained to ensure rapid feedback in case of any non-compliance

Able to develop and manage 2 x GCB 5 testers who will assist with test case script development, script execution in test environment (RADAR), validation of test outcomes to test expectations, investigations of unexpected outcomes

Able to engage at a senior level with Product Owner, Reporting Owner, Reporting Ops leads and ensure communication of compliance outcomes, tracking of delivery, and managing output.

Working knowledge of SQL to run query’s as required in the cloud platform test environment to support test case formulation, and to understand any logic build to verify code compliance to requirement.

Experience with use of ETL documents and related SQL scripts to understand detailed data transformations as well as being able to explain these to less technical colleagues

Understanding of banking products and the financial industry, with familiarity to complex trading structures such as Repos, Collateral Swaps and Derivatives

Competence in dealing with large complex datasets and using data analysis skills to manipulate and interrogate the data to produce findings

Able to engage with Finance Change business analysts, design & build and data analysts in cases of any non-compliance items found which require further remedial build, clearly articulating the cause of the non-compliance and the proposed remediation.

Able to engage with Reporting Ops to articulate all test findings, including compliant and non-compliant findings, alongside expected impact of any change requirements due to non-compliance defect fixes.

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity

 At New Relic, we provide our customers real-time insights, so they can innovate faster. Our software delivers insightful observability tools across different technologies and distributed systems, enabling software engineering teams to identify, understand, and tackle issues, analyze performance, and maximize their software and infrastructure.

The Developer Platform organization is looking for a Software Engineering Manager to join our group in India. This organization develops and maintains the internal developer platform, security, compliance and audit reporting and all processes and controls that enable New Relic’s fleet of engineers to effectively release our products to customers. Developer Platform teams work across all engineering teams to implement critical projects to support our business.

Our Engineering Managers are a select group of technology leaders and mentors who shape the solutions we bring to the market and foster an inclusive environment that brings out the best in people.
If you have a strong technical background but you are also a person with great mentoring skills and that knows how to collaborate with multiple teams to ship great software, we would like to hear from you.

 

What you’ll do

  • Treat the internal developer platform as a product. Define roadmaps, manage backlogs, and prioritize features based on internal engineer needs and business objectives.
  • Drive and contribute to our culture of operational and business efficiency: secure code, CI/CD pipelines, unit testing, regression testing, uptime, using smart telemetry data to make decisions, investment in technical and infrastructure debt, and blameless root-cause analysis with a learner and growth mindset.
  • Design and promote "golden paths" that standardize development, deployment, and testing, reducing friction by fostering self-service environments.
  • Attend operational review meetings and bring postmortem learnings back to the team and organization.
  • Learn from some of the brightest minds in the business—who are also looking to learn from you—while coaching and mentoring people.
  • Drive the recruitment, training, and development of top-tier talent in the region.
  • Regularly collaborate with PMs, technical leaders, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and execute cross-team initiatives.
  • Work in an agile environment with a DevOps approach, where teams build and maintain their own software, including participating in second-layer support rotations.

 

This role requires

  • 10+ years of professional work experience in software development.
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, or equivalent education/experience in a relevant field.
  • Hands-on experience coding in programming languages such as Golang, Java, Javascript or Python.
  • Hands-on experience driving the software architecture and design of large-scale, multi-tiered, distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using service-oriented architecture, object-oriented design, and RESTful API endpoints.
  • 6+ years of people management experience.
  • 5+ years of experience with tools such as Jenkins, ArgoCD, Temporal, Terraform, and Kubernetes.
  • Solid background in application and system programming, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and Linux system administration.
  • Deep understanding of the security, reliability, performance, and cost-effectiveness of distributed systems on public cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud (GCP).



Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. title: Liquidity Reporting- data analyst
description:
Job title: Liquidity reporting Compliance

 

Finance has mobilised a multi-year Integrity of Regulatory Reporting (IRR) programme to ensure that Regulatory

Reporting across the Group is fit for purpose; accurate, timely and complete. The IRR programme is responsible for

overseeing the design and implementation of a set of standards and control outcomes that will be consistently applied

across the end-to-end Regulatory Reporting Process. IRR will drive the interconnectivity across various strategic

transformation programs to ensure linkages and dependencies are well understood and aligned to the IRR standards and

control outcomes.

The Liquidity Product Based Review (LIQ_PBR) workstream is part of the overall data controls framework for Liquidity

Regulatory Reporting. Product Based Reviews enable Finance to develop key assurance that the end to end data flow for

Business Data Elements (“BDE’s”), from upstream Primary Booking Systems to downstream Reporting data warehouses

(including the Liquidity Reporting Finance Data Application / Platform) complies with the applicable group data standards

and controls (‘DMOV’ and ‘DUSE’), is complete and valid for the production of key Liquidity reports and metrics and that

data quality or completeness issues discovered through the PBR process are appropriately logged, reported, escalated and

managed to resolution.

The LIQ_PBR Data Analyst contributes to Global Finance, supporting data flow discovery and documentation, from

upstream primary trading and booking systems (PTS) to downstream Liquidity reporting platforms. The role holder will

support the Liquidity PBR workstream to undertake quantitative and qualitative data documentation, test case

formulation, data test execution and results tabulation, in order to provide the necessary assurance for management with

regards to the traceability, lineage, transformation and controls on Liquidity business data elements from source systems

to reporting. In this regards, the LIQ PBR data analyst will work with Liquidity SMEs to document BDEs that require to be

traced from upstream sources, liaise with upstream data source RTB teams to develop a data flow architecture for the

movement of data, further request sample transactional and other data to test the data per test cases developed to ensure

that transformation logic is per expectation, and present the results to management with appropriate follow through in

case of exceptions and non-expected findings. The LIQ_PBR data analyst will also document and test the data handling

and transformation controls applicable at stage of the data flow from source systems to downstream reporting platforms.

The Liquidity Business Analyst will:

  • Apply approaches, tools and techniques for gathering, clarifying and managing business requirements, including data

analysis on large datasets

  • Support colleagues to define, develop and translate requirements at specific stages of the project lifecycle, developing

an understanding of different types of requirements and how these translate into test cases

  • Based on the data and requirements analysis & understanding, define the design options that will comply with Finance

design principles, contributing to building functionality into Finance target architecture

  • Execute functional and business testing of requirements – and support the users through the User Acceptance Testing

description:

    • Persuasiveness
    • Pro-activeness

description:

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:

Your opportunity

Are you ready to step into a pivotal leadership role where your engineering depth directly shapes the future of our core platform? As our new Engineering Manager, you will lead a talented, distributed team across US and EU time zones, acting as the critical manager bridging regional collaboration.

Our Cloud Foundation team is the backbone of the New Relic platform. In this role, you won't just manage tasks; you will mentor and empower engineers, transitioning our operational framework from a reactive state to a culture of proactive ownership and engineering excellence. You will oversee critical global initiatives, including major regional expansions into FedRAMP High / IL4, India, and Australia. If you thrive on solving complex multi-cloud challenges at an exabyte scale while helping engineers grow in their careers, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


What you'll do

  • Empower & Mentor: Lead and nurture a high-performing engineering team across the US and EU, facilitating career development, performance growth, and a collaborative team culture.
  • Drive Strategic Ownership: Champion a shift from reactive delivery to proactive technical ownership, establishing best practices for platform reliability and cross-regional alignment.
  • Lead Regional Expansions: Architect and execute key global infrastructure expansions across complex environments (including FedRAMP High / IL4, India, and Australia).
  • Architect for Extreme Scale: Guide decisions around microservices, Go-based services, and extreme-scale cellular architectures capable of handling sub-second latency data ingestion and stream processing.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, Security, and Product teams to align roadmaps, remove delivery blockers, and safeguard production reliability.
  • Maintain Operational Rigour: Oversee production environments and high-severity incident responses, championing robust GitOps and infrastructure-as-code practices.

This role requires

  • 8+ years of total software engineering experience with 2–4+ years of direct people management experience. A BS/BA degree or equivalent practical experience is required.
  • Technical Depth in Go & Microservices: Hands-on proficiency in Golang (including performance tuning and concurrency) sufficient to mentor engineers and conduct code reviews.
  • Containerisation at Scale: Proven expertise in Kubernetes and Docker for managing cloud-native microservices and integration workflows.
  • Operations-Heavy Mindset: Demonstrated experience managing production environments, coordinating on-call rotations, and leading high-severity incident responses in 24/7 SaaS or distributed environments.
  • Cross-Regional Alignment: Proven success managing or collaborating with distributed teams across time zones (US Central/Eastern time zones required to align with EU/US schedules).

Bonus points if you have

  • Multi-Cloud & Compliance: Depth across AWS, Azure, or GCP, with experience navigating strict security frameworks like FedRAMP High / IL4.
  • Infrastructure & Streaming Tooling: Operational experience with Kafka, Helm, GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Flux), and Terraform (or Atlantis).
  • AI & Automation: Familiarity with AI tools/LLMs (Claude, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) for automated operational analysis and remediation, or exposure to open standards like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Observability Domain: Prior background in B2B SaaS or the Observability domain.


Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Job Title: Hybrid Collateral Project Manager


Location: India

Job Description: Hybrid Collateral Project Manager & Business Analyst

Exp - 12 -25 yrs

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager and Business Analyst with a strong background in Treasury, Liquidity Risk management, and product expertise in Collateral Loans and Securities. The ideal candidate will have demonstrable experience in IT integration projects, be adept at planning and tracking delivery, and possess a solid understanding of Agile methodologies.

This role requires running working groups, ensuring effective communication across stakeholders, and presenting complex information to senior management. The role also requires strong Business Analysis capability: eliciting and documenting requirements, mapping end-to-end processes, defining target operating models, and translating business needs into clear deliverables for technology and change teams. Experience with Non-Financial Risk (NFR) and controls is essential.

 

Key Responsibilities

Project Management (PM)

● Lead and manage end-to-end project delivery for Treasury and Collateral product initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements.

● Develop detailed project plans, track progress, manage risks, and ensure timely delivery of milestones.

● Facilitate working groups, driving collaboration between business, technology, and control functions.

● Apply Agile principles to project execution, fostering iterative development and continuous improvement.

● Integrate IT solutions with existing Treasury and Collateral systems, ensuring seamless transition and minimal disruption.

● Monitor and report on project status, escalating issues and proposing solutions as necessary.

Business Analysis (BA)

● Partner with business and technology stakeholders to elicit, analyse, validate, and document requirements (business, functional, non-functional).

● Conduct as-is/to-be process analysis, identify gaps, and propose pragmatic solutions aligned to strategic direction.

● Support design workshops and working sessions to drive clarity on scope, assumptions, dependencies, and outcomes.

● Translate complex Treasury/Collateral product needs into deliverables that engineers, testers, and operations teams can execute against.

● Support UAT planning and execution: define test scenarios, coordinate defect triage, and ensure business sign-off aligns to documented acceptance criteria.

● Contribute to implementation readiness (operating model impacts, cutover approach, training/support needs, and post-go-live controls).

Governance, Controls & Stakeholder Management

● Prepare high-quality papers and presentations for senior management, distilling complex topics into actionable insights.

● Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, adapting style and content as required.

● Ensure robust NFR and control frameworks are embedded throughout the project lifecycle, including traceability from requirements through to testing and implementation.

● Support risk and issue management, ensuring impacts are understood and mitigations are agreed with relevant stakeholders.

 

Required Skills & Experience

● Proven experience in Treasury, Liquidity Risk, and Collateral Loans/Securities products.

● Strong track record of IT integration within financial services.

● Advanced project management skills, including planning, tracking, RAID management, and delivery governance.

● Demonstrated Business Analysis experience, including: Requirements elicitation and documentation (functional and non-functional) Process mapping (BPMN or equivalent), gap analysis, and solution options Agile delivery artefacts (epics, user stories, acceptance criteria) and backlog management UAT support, defect triage, and business sign-off Stakeholder management across Front Office, Risk, Operations, Technology, and Control functions

● Deep understanding of Agile methodologies and practical application in delivery environments.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to write papers and deliver presentations to senior audiences.

● Experience running cross-functional working groups.

● Knowledge of NFR and controls, with ability to implement and monitor risk frameworks.

● Highly effective communicator, able to influence and engage at all levels.

Job Description:

Job Title: Tester 


Location: India

Role purpose

Own and execute data-focused manual UAT, ensuring end-to-end processing integrity across UI, database layers, interfaces, and downstream operational reporting. Drive the transition of UAT management from Excel-based tracking to Jira, producing audit-ready evidence and clear release readiness recommendations.

Key responsibilities

· Perform strong SQL-driven data testing and reconciliation across multiple systems/sources, evidencing outcomes with repeatable queries and extracts.

· Validate end-to-end processing using database reconciliations, interface reports/extracts, and batch outputs to confirm completeness and accuracy.

Tools & technology

· SQL

· Jira

· Qlik Sense, Tableau

· Advanced Excel, MS Office Suite

· Big Query

· SharePoint

title: Manager, Workplace & Facilities Operations
description:
About the Team

You will be joining the Real Estate and Workplace Operations (REWO) team within DoorDash’s Finance Organization. We design, build, and operate inclusive, inspiring, and functional spaces that help employees do their best work, removing physical friction so teams can focus on what matters.

About the Role

This role leads day-to-day Workplace and Facilities operations for our India site. You will drive efficient, employee-focused operations on the ground, combining hands-on operational expertise, vendor management, and team leadership to execute workplace strategy set by regional and global leadership.  This is an overnight position that will also require working some weekends. 

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and develop an insourced and outsourced Workplace and Facilities team on-site, maintaining consistency in operations, service delivery, and employee experience.
  • Set team goals aligned with organizational objectives; define clear performance metrics and hold the team accountable to them.
  • Implement processes, playbooks, and initiatives that align with global workplace strategies and drive operational efficiency.
  • Support space planning and allocation to accommodate evolving organizational needs, balancing functionality, employee experience, and cost.
  • Coordinate office events to ensure they reflect company culture and deliver engaging, impactful experiences.
  • Ensure all facilities meet local regulations, safety standards, and company policies; partner with cross-functional teams to stay ahead of changing requirements.
  • Partner with the Global Operations Center on crisis scenarios (natural disasters, evacuations, pandemics) and help the team execute business continuity plans.
  • Manage vendor and contractor relationships for food, beverages, and essential services including contract administration, renewals, RFPs, and ongoing service level assessments.
  • Support Real Estate on lease renewals, new builds, and renovations to ensure smooth day-one operations.
  • Use occupancy data, employee surveys, and spend analysis to inform local workplace decisions and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Manage the site's operating budget, including financial variance tracking and cost-saving initiatives that maintain service quality.
  • Support change management for workplace initiatives, communicating clearly and consistently with stakeholders throughout.
  • Deliver regular updates to leadership on operations, project progress, and KPIs; maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Build collaborative relationships with cross-functional partners, landlords, vendors, and contractors.
  • Partner with the Sustainability Team to support environmental improvements at the office location.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of Workplace leadership experience managing a team.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to mentor and develop team members, build cross-functional partnerships, and foster a high-performance culture. Comfortable setting goals, adapting quickly, and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to present clearly across levels. Strong interpersonal skills and a relationship-first approach.
  • Organization & Execution: Highly organized and detail-oriented; thrives in fast-paced environments and ensures nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Problem Solving: Proactive and solutions-oriented, with sound judgment and the ability to anticipate needs and act independently when required.
  • Vendor Management: Experience managing infrastructure service providers (custodial, catering, maintenance, etc.).
  • Project Management: Ability to manage cross-functional projects from planning through completion, including office construction and renovation logistics.
  • Budget Management: Familiarity with budget tracking, financial planning, and procurement/sourcing processes.
  • Technology: Hands-on with Google Suite, Jira, Coupa, Slack, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Sigma. Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.
  • Flexibility: Able to work in-office 5 days a week, travel ~10%, and work overnight shifts including weekends.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with workplace trends (hybrid/remote work, workplace design) and their impact on collaboration and productivity.

 

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Engineering Manager, Identity & Access
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are seeking an Engineering Manager (Warsaw, Poland) with a strong technical background in full-stack development to lead our Identity and Access engineering staff. In this leadership role, you will manage, mentor, and grow a team of full-stack engineers responsible for building and maintaining the systems and interfaces that authenticate users, allow agents to scale on our public APIs, and enable self-service product configuration.

You will guide your team in leveraging Addepar’s enterprise identity platform to create responsive, frictionless user journeys. These range from the “front door” of our products (such as login and MFA) to the administrative tools our customers use to configure experiences for their internal teams and end-clients.

Collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and engineering partners, you will ensure our delivery aligns with our clients' complex regional, compliance, and privacy needs. Ultimately, you will foster an environment of engineering excellence, empowering your team to build the next generation of features that prepare Addepar for the demands of modern, AI-driven users.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage, mentor, and recruit a team of full-stack software engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and collaboration.
  • Partner with Product and Design to define roadmaps, plan sprints, and ensure the successful, timely delivery of user and customer configuration tools built on Addepar’s identity platform.
  • Oversee the team's technical strategy as they migrate Addepar’s authentication experiences to new platforms, ensuring global availability and scalable user experiences.
  • Align architectural, strategic identity investments with product-driven improvements, acting as a key stakeholder in technical design and architecture reviews.
  • Support the team's operational health by implementing agile best practices, managing technical debt, and maintaining high standards for code quality, testing, and production stability.

Who You Are

  • Extensive professional software engineering experience, with 2+ years of experience directly managing or leading software engineering teams.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or other quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Solid background in full-stack development (e.g., Java/object-oriented backend systems and modern web frameworks like React, Svelte, or Ember) to effectively guide technical discussions and system design
  • Deep understanding of identity fundamentals, secure session management, and modern authentication/authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWTs, SAML)
  • Demonstrated ability to recruit, coach, and retain top engineering talent while managing performance and supporting career growth
  • Problem-solving skills with the ability to explore complex problem spaces objectively from multiple perspectives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering and non-engineering teams
  • Self-driven and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift

Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions.

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for this role within Warsaw.

Compensation for this role includes base salary.Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process.

Base Salary Range
425 000 zł—510 000 zł PLN

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.
