title: Staff Software Engineer - Trading
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are currently seeking a highly experienced Backend Software Engineer with a strong Java background to join our Trading suite of products—including Rebalancing, Order Management System (OMS), and Investment Book of Record (IBOR).

We’re building a scalable, tax-efficient trading & rebalancing platform for wealth management firms of all sizes. The platform will target sophisticated rebalancing strategies across equities, mutual funds and fixed income products and send trades to be completed in the market. 

You will play a significant role in driving complex, long-term technical designs from concept to delivery, ensuring our solutions are scalable, resilient, and secure. You will leverage your deep expertise in software design patterns and distributed systems to solve challenging problems and pioneer the adoption of new technologies. While you will educate and empower other engineers, this is fundamentally a hands-on technical leadership role where you will work closely with product and design teams to deliver exceptional products for our clients.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect, implement, and maintain engineering solutions to solve complex problems; write well-designed, testable code.
  • Lead individual project priorities, deadlines, and solutions.
  • Collaborate effectively with product managers, engineers, and partners on projects.
  • Active support of business needs during US hours.Act as an engineering representative to the client and product support and steer communications from engineering standpoints.
  • Communicate technical ideas and set direction on projects with a focus on solving business challenges.
  • Mentor other engineers on the team.
  • Participate in the design and development of a strategic product for Addepar.
  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code that's also scalable and extensible

Who You Are

  • B.S., or M.S. in Computer Science or similar technical field of study (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency in backend development, with a focus on Java.
  • Experience with databases, SQL, NoSQL, OLAP, and/or data lake architectures
  • You have a deep and expert knowledge of software design patterns, API design, and the software development lifecycle
  • Proven ability to influence technical direction and make significant contributions to the architecture of complex, distributed systems
  • Expertise in cloud platforms, preferably AWS
  • Comfortable working in a cloud context, with automated infrastructure and service-oriented architecture
  • You have a track record of amplifying your impact by mentoring other engineers 
  • A strong ownership mentality and drive to solve the most important problems.
  • Experience with Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and related technologies is preferred

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

$187,000—$234,000 USD

  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.

  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. title: Insurance System Operations Analyst
description:

Alteryx/UiPath Developer - BA Automation Specialist

Experience: 5-8 years
Location: Mumbai

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Operations Automation Specialist to work closely with Operations teams to identify manual, repetitive, inefficient, and risk-prone processes and convert them into scalable automation solutions. The role will use technologies such as Alteryx, UiPath, Power BI, Excel/VBA, and other workflow automation platforms.

This position will support the Operations transformation agenda by improving process efficiency, reducing manual touchpoints, strengthening controls, lowering operational risk, and contributing to departmental automation and capacity-saving objectives. Alteryx will primarily be used to automate complex, manual, Excel-based processes, while UiPath will be used to automate repetitive, rules-based activities to improve efficiency and productivity.

The successful candidate will have a strong analytical mindset, a practical understanding of Operations processes, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision. They should be confident engaging directly with Operations subject-matter experts, identifying process pain points, translating business needs into automation solutions, and delivering production-ready outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Process Discovery and Opportunity Assessment

  • Partner with Operations teams to understand process pain points, manual activities, recurring issues, control gaps, and operational inefficiencies.
  • Assess processes for automation suitability, considering repeatability, data availability, transaction volumes, potential effort savings, risk reduction, and scalability.
  • Translate operational challenges into clearly defined automation use cases, business requirements, and measurable benefit cases.
  • Support automation idea intake, benefit tracking, prioritisation, and delivery-readiness activities.

Automation Development and Delivery

  • Design, develop, test, and implement automation solutions using Alteryx and UiPath, with potential integration across Excel, Outlook, Power BI, SharePoint, and other Operations tools.
  • Build Alteryx workflows to transform, reconcile, validate, and prepare operational data.
  • Develop UiPath automations for repetitive, rules-based activities, including downloading files, navigating systems, extracting data, preparing reports, routing information, and reducing manual intervention.
  • Ensure solutions are robust, controlled, scalable, easy for Operations users to run, and straightforward to maintain.
  • Produce runbooks, user guides, control documentation, and handover materials for business-as-usual teams.

Required Skills and Experience

Advanced Alteryx / Power BI knowledge including Alteryx Server / Power BI Cloud experience

  • Alteryx – Ability to develop complex workflows connecting to multiple data sources
  • Power BI – Being able to write DAX functions is a must to be considered advanced enough for the role
  • UiPath – Ability to develop bots using UiPath StudioX
  • Strong analytical skills coupled with ability to support and upskill users in using the tool and building their solutions
  • Data connectivity experience helpful

Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Alteryx Designer, including data preparation, joins, transformations, filtering, reconciliation logic, workflow optimisation, and output generation.
  • Practical experience with UiPath or comparable robotic process automation tools used to automate repetitive, rules-based operational activities.
  • Strong Excel skills. Experience with VBA, Power Query, Power BI, SharePoint Lists, and Power Automate would be advantageous.
  • Ability to work with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.
  • Understanding of the automation delivery lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, user acceptance testing, production deployment, documentation, and ongoing support.
  • Familiarity with automation idea intake, prioritization, or benefit-tracking processes would be beneficial.

Behavioral Skills

  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal guidance.
  • Strong analytical capability and attention to detail.
  • Curious, solution-focused, and comfortable challenging inefficient manual processes.
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to explain technical solutions to non-technical Operations users.
  • Ability to manage priorities across multiple automation initiatives.
  • Collaborative approach, with the ability to establish trust with Operations subject-matter experts and senior stakeholders.

More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

This is a highly visible domain within R&D as it directly impacts developer experience and efficiency, but also within Addepar as the commercial opportunity for Sandboxes to accelerate customer adoption and build product led revenue streams is significant.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Execute the Platform Services product roadmap aligned with developer and end customer adoption and satisfaction
  • Design isolated testing environments with realistic test data, simulated workflows, and feature parity to production

Platform & Infrastructure

  • Ability to build defensible commercial models, tracking customer adoption rates and satisfaction

$178,000—$223,000 USD

title: Associate Creative Director - Design
description:
At Kulfi Collective, we are a diverse team of storytellers, technologists, and cultural enthusiasts who believe in the power of content to shape minds and inspire change. We are on a mission to create original and branded content that resonates with Gen Y and Gen Z audiences, merging authentic narratives with cutting-edge digital experiences.

Associate Creative Director, Design

Reporting to   Executive Creative Director
Type   Full-Time
Location   Worli, Mumbai (Hybrid)

THE KIND OF WORK YOU'LL SHAPE

Some days it's a campaign key visual. Other days it's packaging or merch, a social series, an event experience, or something nobody's designed for yet. The medium keeps changing. The ask doesn't: take an idea and give it a shape people remember.
You'll work across brands at very different stages, some with tightly-guarded global systems already in place, some where the visual language is still being written. Both are part of the job.

ROLE

This role isn't about designing what you're told. It's about shaping what gets designed in the first place.
You'll bring sharp visual thinking to concepts as they're being built, get fluent fast in whatever brand you're on (guidelines already locked globally, or ones we're still defining), and figure out if a brief needs campaign thinking, social thinking, branding, or packaging and merch, sometimes all four.
This is a thinker-and-doer role. You'll come up with the idea and get hands-on to make it real.

WHAT YOU'LL DRIVE

  • Turn ideas into visual concepts across campaign, social, branding and packaging/merch, whatever the brief calls for
  • Get fluent in each brand's world fast: its guidelines, its references, its audience, whether that system is already locked globally or you're defining it here
  • Direct  animated films/series or lead the design direction for shorter assets such as 10-second CTAs/ bumpers etc
  • Bring a sharp point of view on trends, tools and visual culture, and use it to push the work further
  • Brief/supervise freelancers or outside collaborators when a project genuinely needs more hands
  • Fold emerging AI tools into your own process
  • Present ideas clearly enough to build consensus, with clients and internally
  • Work independently across multiple live projects at once, without close direction

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

  • You shape the idea, not just the execution
  • You'll work across formats and mediums, not one lane
  • You bring the thinking and the making. This role rewards both equally

WHO YOU ARE

  • 4 to 6 years of experience (less if your portfolio makes the case)
  • Comes from a brand and campaign design background, the traditional art direction world.
  • Not a one-style designer within that world. You move between campaign, social, branding and packaging/merch thinking depending on what's needed
  • A strong eye for different design styles and movements, brutalism, baroque, minimalism, mixed media, neo-pop, and a read on what's currently trending, and why
  • A thinker and a doer. Equally comfortable coming up with the idea and getting hands-on to execute it yourself
  • Strong in Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Already curious about, and using, AI tools in your process
  • Can present and defend ideas clearly enough to build consensus
  • Can work autonomously across multiple projects, without hand-holding

BEFORE YOU APPLY
It's a good fit if:

  • You can defend your ideas, not just show them
  • Your background is in brand or campaign design, classic art direction.
  • You've worked across more than one format or medium, and enjoyed the range

title: Sr. Account Executive- Enterprise
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

Addepar’s Enterprise Sales team partners with some of the largest wealth management firms globally, including many listed on the Barron’s Top 40.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will lead complex, consultative sales efforts with a small set of highly strategic clients. This is a senior role with responsibility for both driving new business and expanding long-term partnerships across global financial institutions.

You will act as the business owner for your accounts, setting strategy, leading execution, and aligning internal teams to deliver meaningful outcomes for clients. This role goes beyond traditional sales; you’ll help shape how leading firms evolve their advisor and client experience through technology.

You’ll operate in a highly cross-functional environment, partnering with teams across Sales Engineering, Client Success, Services, Partnerships, Marketing, and R&D to deliver a consistent, high-quality experience from initial engagement through long-term growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and grow strategic relationships - Build, expand, and deepen relationships with key enterprise clients. Drive new business, renewals, and multi-year expansion opportunities across your portfolio.
  • Lead consultative enterprise sales cycles - Own complex, multi-stakeholder deals across large financial institutions, often spanning regions, business lines, and senior decision-makers.
  • Set account strategy and drive execution - Develop and execute thoughtful, multi-year account plans aligned to client priorities and Addepar’s broader GTM strategy.
  • Operate as a cross-functional leader - Work closely with Sales Engineering, Client Success, Services, and Partnerships to deliver a coordinated, “one team” experience—minimizing friction and maximizing client impact.
  • Engage at the executive level - Build trusted relationships with C-level stakeholders within client organizations and partner with Addepar’s leadership team when appropriate to advance strategic opportunities.
  • Contribute to how we go to market - Bring perspective from your experience and from the field—sharing best practices, shaping engagement models, and helping evolve how we serve enterprise clients.
  • Maintain strong pipeline and forecasting discipline - Ensure timely, accurate pipeline management and forecasting to support internal alignment and planning.

Who You Are

  • Proven enterprise seller - You bring significant experience leading complex SaaS or platform sales cycles, ideally within wealth management or financial services.
  • Client-focused and outcomes-driven-  You have a track record of building long-term relationships and delivering meaningful results for clients.
  • Strategic and consultative - You know how to navigate large organizations, ask the right questions, and align solutions to broader business objectives.
  • Executive communicator - You’re comfortable engaging senior stakeholders and can clearly articulate complex ideas in a way that resonates.
  • Collaborative by nature - You work well across teams and understand how to bring the right people together to move deals forward and support clients over time.
  • Curious and continuously learning - You bring your own perspective and best practices, while also being open to learning and evolving how we operate.
  • Self-directed and accountable - You’re comfortable operating with autonomy as we continue to grow and evolve our enterprise business.

Our GTM team members come from a variety of different backgrounds, experiences, and cultures, yet all exemplify the following attributes:

  • Deeply connected to our mission as an organization and to each other
  • Experience and passion for driving successful client experiences
  • Outcome driven mindset
  • Strong communication skills
  • Consultative selling approach
  • Collaborative mentality with the ability to mold consensus through thought leadership and a data-driven strategy
  • Reputation for being a trusted colleague and thought partner to colleagues and clients
  • Strong intellectual horsepower
  • Strong technical proficiency
  • Desire to both teach and learn

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

We are looking for a Data Validation Specialist to join our team and support the data conversion for new Addepar clients. This role involves cross-referencing large sets of financial data between spreadsheets and systems, helping to ensure accuracy during onboarding. You’ll play a key part in identifying and tracking any inconsistencies, with clear documentation and attention to detail being the most important parts of the job.

This is primarily a non-client-facing role that plays a key part behind the scenes, requiring focus, consistency, and comfort with repetitive work.  It’s a great fit for someone who enjoys working with data in a structured way and takes pride in getting the details right.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Dive Deep into Data: Review and compare client data across spreadsheets and platforms to identify inconsistencies or gaps 
  • Document and Log: Thoroughly document and log all your findings in a clear, standardized format
  • Collaborate: Work closely with Project Leads who will guide your research and analysis and act as the main point of contact for our clients
  • Manage Multiple Projects: Prioritize and context-switch effectively to complete simultaneous projects; seeing each through to the finish line
  • Identify and implement AI-driven automation and LLM integrations to streamline implementation

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, ideally in Business, Finance, Math, Economics, or another data-oriented field
  • 1+ year(s) of experience in a structured, detail-focused role such as data entry, financial operations, or data quality assurance
  • Strong organizational skills with a focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team environment
  • Proficiency with spreadsheets (e.g., Excel), internal tools, and web-based platforms
  • Familiarity with financial data is a plus, but not required. Quick to learn new systems and follow structured processes for data navigation and validation
  • Effective time management skills and the ability to balance multiple priorities

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.

title: IT Support Specialist
description:
About the Team

The IT Service Desk and IT Asset Management Teams provide complete, real-time support to DoorDash employees needing IT support or IT equipment. These teams partner closely with other areas of the business and IT to ensure we are always providing the highest level of support to our colleagues, ensuring they can do the best work of their careers.

About the Role

This is a cross functional role between IT Service Desk and IT Asset Management. You will provide dedicated onsite IT support to employees, in addition to handling ticket-based support. You will resolve some tickets independently, while others may require collaboration or escalation to other teams for further assistance. You will also assist with asset inventory, receive asset deliveries, and follow all asset tracking and lifecycle procedures. You will also work closely with the new hire onboarding process, setting up devices and accessories. Additionally, you will frequently collaborate with your peers and partners within the IT department, focusing on process improvements and efficiencies to continuously enhance our ability to support customers. This role requires you to be onsite at our Sao Paulo office.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Ensure the highest levels of customer service in a collaborative environment while helping people resolve IT related issues and requests.
  • Maintain a balanced focus on security and efficiency, keeping company values at the forefront of all decisions.
  • Troubleshoot end user technical issues via phone, chat, email, or onsite at local office.
  • Accurately log/document all Service Desk issues and work efforts using our service management solution.
  • Identify and research routine technical problems of varying complexity and follow through to resolution.
  • Tracking and maintaining an up to date inventory of all IT assets located in Sao Paulo
  • Following all IT asset and inventory management processes for hardware.
  • Managing relationships with hardware vendors, coordinating asset deliveries, handling procurement logistics, and communicating updates to end users
  • Manage and maintain AV equipment in conference rooms (neatboard, neatbar, TV’s, mics).
  • Configure, deploy and support Zoom Room technologies and troubleshooting system issues.
  • Provide AV support for company events and presentations.
  • Collaborate on corporate-wide initiatives and team projects.
  • Effectively manage and engage with local cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements, align on priorities, and drive successful operations outcomes.
  • Be a customer advocate by seeking to identify common issues, working within the business to eliminate future occurrences, and proactively educating customers with helpful hints or business-based best practices.
  • Provide on-call support within the team's rotation.

We’re excited about you because…

  • Helping people problem-solve is your passion.
  • You thrive in a fast paced customer service environment, preferably within a technical organization
  • You enjoy supporting and troubleshooting macOS, ChromeOS and/or Windows platform issues
  • You've spent time working in and around iOS and/or Android platforms
  • You really know your way around the setup and configuration of end-user desktops/laptops, computer hardware, software, printers, phones, cell phones, and peripherals
  • You are at ease using cloud-based communication services such as Slack, Gmail, and Zoom to collaborate with others
  • You want to help grow and create a Service Desk people love and can rely on.

Desired Skills and Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years experience in a technical support environment
  • Strong familiarity with MacOS, ChromeOS and Windows OS platforms
  • Strong familiarity with Google suite of applications (Sheets/Docs/Gmail/etc.)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong familiarity with IT asset management tools and processes, including lifecycle tracking, inventory control, and compliance with asset policies.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as: Python, Bash, or similar.
  • Ability to document complex technical issues consistently and thoroughly
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Strong customer service skills.
  • Skills in project management/prioritization of work.
  • Experience with Okta and/or other SaaS-based identity management solutions
  • Familiarity with Mosyle, Intune, or other MDM solutions
  • Ability to move equipment as necessary - up to 50lbs 
  • Occasional travel to other DoorDash sites and offices as required 

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

title: Software Engineer Manager (Database Observability)
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity

At New Relic, we provide our customers real-time insights, so they can innovate faster. Our software delivers insightful observability tools across different technologies and distributed systems, enabling software engineering teams to quickly identify, understand and tackle issues, analyze performance and get the most of their software and infrastructure.

Database Observability is a critical pillar of New Relic's platform strategy. We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager (M3) to lead a senior, high-performing team building next-generation Database Observability products. Your team will own the entire lifecycle of critical telemetry data flows from lightweight database agents and high-throughput ingestion pipelines to intelligent DB recommendation engines and autonomous DB AI Agents.

You will lead a team that includes senior and Lead-level engineers with deep domain expertise in distributed systems and AI. Your primary value will come from setting strategic technical direction, enabling their best work, and fostering a high-accountability culture while partnering closely with Product and Design to deliver features that directly drive New Relic's Database Observability.

What you'll do

  • Manage a full-stack engineering team (6–8 engineers) spanning backend systems, database telemetry, agent engineering, and UI workflows.
  • Own end-to-end delivery sprint planning, roadmap execution, system quality, and operational excellence for critical database ingestion and recommendation pipelines.
  • Guide the team in harnessing cutting-edge AI technologies including Agentic AI, MCP, and LLMs to evolve database observability from passive monitoring to automated, AI-driven diagnostics and remediation.
  • Drive architectural discussions around high-throughput, low-latency ingestion, streaming telemetry (Kafka), and database agent development, holding the team to high engineering excellence standards.
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Design to translate high-level vision into actionable, well-engineered execution plans..
  • Hire, mentor, and grow engineers at every level. Set clear expectations, manage performance equitably, and build a visible talent pipeline.
  • Build a strong DevOps culture where teams own what they ship ensuring robust monitoring, incident response, CI/CD automation, and high reliability.
  • Champion modern engineering workflows, including AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate delivery and spec-driven development.

This role requires

  • 10+ years of total software engineering experience with 2+ years directly managing engineering teams.
  • Proven track record of coaching, guiding, and retaining individual contributors ,enabling domain experts rather than directing them.
  • Deep technical background in backend and distributed systems (Go, Java, Python, or equivalent) with the ability to engage credibly in architecture discussions around high throughput, low latency, and data pipelines.
  • Foundational understanding of database engines (Relational and NoSQL) and the challenges of safely collecting performance metrics under heavy production loads.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives on time with high quality, alongside experience managing team health, technical debt, and performance expectations.
  • Clear, direct, and transparent communication style effective at aligning senior engineers, cross-functional partners, and executive stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with modern practices including CI/CD, microservices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and production observability.

 

Bonus points if you have

  • Background in Observability, Database Engineering, SRE, or Performance Tuning domains.
  • Exposure to Agentic AI, LLM application architecture, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Experience with real-time streaming architectures (Apache Kafka) and database collector/agent design.
  • Hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) standards.
  • Active experience guiding teams through AI-assisted development practices (e.g., spec-driven development using Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor).
  • Track record of managing teams through rapid scaling or ground-up product launches.
  • Familiarity with Kafka, GraphQL, or distributed data systems
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development practices (spec-driven dev, Claude Code, Copilot)

Why Join Us:

  • Be part of a forward-thinking team working with cutting-edge technologies in a collaborative environment.
  • Access to opportunities for professional growth and development, including mentorship, learning resources, and a culture that encourages continuous improvement.
  • We believe in maintaining a healthy work-life balance with flexible work hours and remote work opportunities.

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes. 

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com.

We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid.

Our hiring process

In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.

New Relic develops and distributes encryption software and technology that complies with U.S. export controls and licensing requirements. Certain New Relic roles require candidates to pass an export compliance assessment as a condition of employment in any global location. If relevant, we will provide more information later in the application process.

Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics. 

Review our Applicant Privacy Notice at https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/applicant-privacy-policy

title: Security Engineer III (~Senior Identity Security Engineer)
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

What you’ll be doing:

As a Senior Identity Security Engineer, you will be a key hands-on contributor to Anaplan’s identity security function. Working as part of a collaborative security team, you will administer and mature our IGA capability, contribute to the build-out of our Privileged Access Management programme, and help shape the governance of non-human and AI agent identities as part of our broader Zero Trust strategy. Your core responsibilities will be to:

 

  • IGA Platform Administration: Be a key contributor to the day-to-day administration and ongoing development of Anaplan’s Identity Governance and Administration platform (currently SailPoint). This includes supporting the full identity lifecycle (joiner, mover, leaver), configuring and maintaining application connectors, building and refining role models, and running access certification campaigns to ensure least-privilege access across the organisation.
  • PAM Programme Build-Out: Play a key role in the evaluation, selection, and initial implementation of Anaplan’s Privileged Access Management capability. Help define requirements, assess tooling options, and work with cross-functional stakeholders to design and deploy a PAM solution covering privileged account discovery and vaulting, just-in-time (JIT) access, session monitoring, and credential rotation.
  • Non-Human Identity (NHI) Lifecycle Management: Contribute to the development and implementation of governance frameworks for non-human identities across the enterprise, including service accounts, API keys, secrets, certificates, and OAuth tokens. Ensure all NHI are inventoried, governed, and subject to appropriate lifecycle controls, integrating with secrets management solutions where applicable.
  • AI Agent Identity & Security: Be a key technical contributor to identity security for AI agents and automated workflows, ensuring appropriate scoping, lifecycle management, and least-privilege access models are applied. Help develop and enforce policies governing how AI agents authenticate, authorise, and interact with Anaplan’s systems and data.
  • Identity Automation & Engineering: Build and maintain automation to streamline identity processes, including provisioning and de-provisioning workflows, access request fulfilment, and lifecycle rule development. Contribute scripts, integrations, and tooling that reduce manual effort and improve accuracy and consistency across identity operations.
  • Access Governance & Compliance: Support access review and certification processes, SoD (Separation of Duties) policy definition and enforcement, and identity-related audit reporting. Contribute to Anaplan’s compliance programmes (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001) by ensuring identity controls are well-documented, consistently applied, and evidenced for audit purposes.
  • Identity Architecture & Strategy: Contribute to the evolution of Anaplan’s identity security architecture, applying Zero Trust principles and advocating for least-privilege and just-in-time access across cloud and on-premises environments. Engage with engineering and platform teams to embed identity security requirements into new and existing systems.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with HR, IT, Engineering, and Security teams to define and maintain access policies, onboarding and offboarding processes, and role-based access models. Communicate identity risks, control gaps, and remediation plans clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

What you’ll bring to the role:

We are looking for an experienced identity security practitioner with deep hands-on IGA expertise and a strong foundation across the broader identity and access management discipline. You will bring:

 

  • IGA Platform Expertise: Demonstrated hands-on experience administering an enterprise IGA platform, with strong preference for SailPoint (IdentityNow or IdentityIQ). Experience should include identity lifecycle management, access certifications, connector configuration, role management, and lifecycle rule development. Familiarity with additional IGA platforms (e.g. Saviynt, Omada, One Identity) is highly desirable, given our intent to maintain platform-agnostic capability.
  • PAM Knowledge & Capability Building: Solid understanding of Privileged Access Management concepts and technologies, including privileged account vaulting, session recording, JIT access, and credential rotation. Prior experience evaluating or implementing a PAM solution is a strong advantage; candidates who have contributed to a PAM programme build from the ground up are particularly sought after.
  • Non-Human Identity Management: Experience governing NHI at scale, including service accounts, API keys, OAuth/OIDC tokens, certificates, and secrets. Familiarity with enterprise secrets management platforms (e.g. HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, CyberArk Conjur) and an understanding of the unique risks associated with unmanaged or over-privileged NHI.
  • AI Agent & Agentic Workflow Identity: Understanding of the identity and access challenges posed by AI agents and automated systems, including how to scope, govern, and lifecycle-manage machine identities operating within or on behalf of AI-driven workflows. Experience in this area is emerging and will be valued highly.
  • Identity Protocols & Standards: Strong working knowledge of core identity protocols and standards including SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, LDAP, and Kerberos, and their practical application in hybrid enterprise environments.
  • Cloud IAM: Hands-on experience with cloud IAM platforms, particularly AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), and/or GCP IAM, including policy design, role management, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM) capabilities.
  • Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages commonly used in identity automation (e.g. Python, PowerShell, Java/BeanShell for SailPoint rule development). Ability to build integrations and workflows that reduce manual identity operations.
  • Security Frameworks & Compliance: Familiarity with identity-relevant security frameworks and compliance standards (e.g. NIST SP 800-63, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2), and an understanding of how IGA and PAM controls map to audit and regulatory requirements.

Communication & Collaboration: Strong ability to translate complex identity security concepts for non-technical stakeholders, and to work cross-functionally across HR, IT, Engineering, and Security to deliver identity outcomes. Clear documentation skills are essential

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.  
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

  • Threat Hunting: Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts to uncover attacker activity that bypasses existing detections. Document findings to inform and enhance detection engineering and tools.
  • Incident Response Support: Provide engineering support during security incidents, aiding in investigation, containment, and recovery. Contribute to post-incident reviews, translating lessons into improved detections and playbooks.

  • Technical Security Experience: Extensive experience in security engineering, DevSecOps, or a similar role, particularly in securing cloud-native environments and modern application stacks.

  • SecOps Tooling: Proficiency in administering and operating core security tools like SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), EDR/XDR solutions, and vulnerability scanners, with experience integrating these tools for detection and response workflows.
  • Threat Intelligence & Threat Hunting: Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms and feeds (e.g., MISP, Recorded Future, VirusTotal), and the ability to integrate intelligence into security tooling and detection logic. Knowledge of threat hunting methodologies is highly desirable.
  • Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, Bash) for building security tools and automating workflows.
  • Application Security Knowledge: Understanding of secure development practices, OWASP top risks, and experience in code reviews or collaboration with developers to address security findings.
  • Security Frameworks & Standards: Knowledge of relevant security frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, MITRE ATT&CK) and compliance standards like SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong ability to communicate technical security risks and recommendations to diverse stakeholders and work cross-functionally to achieve security objectives.
  • Incident Response & Digital Forensics: Experience leading or supporting security incident investigations, including evidence preservation, log analysis, timeline reconstruction, and root cause identification. Familiarity with forensic tools and methodologies is highly valued.

The DoorDash Labs Recruiting Team is focused on building the DoorDash Labs culture, one quality hire at a time. We partner with the Labs hiring teams to develop recruiting strategies that enable DoorDash to hire remarkable technical talent in the most efficient and unbiased ways.

About the Role

As a Technical Recruiter at DoorDash Labs, you will play an essential part in supporting our growing India Operations team by working with our hiring managers, engineers, and executives to hire top technical talent. You will report directly to the Technical Recruiting Manager.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Partner closely with our Labs Engineering leaders to hire top engineers across multiple teams
  • Partner with the hiring managers and their team to develop creative strategies for engaging with and closing top talent
  • Drive large-scale talent acquisition initiatives by planning and executing mass hiring drives and campus recruitment campaigns
  • Help influence hiring decisions at each point in the recruiting process
  • Use data, your knowledge, and industry trends to build creative closing strategies

  • You have an in-depth understanding of market mapping, talent research, and candidate identification
  • You have mastered successful pipeline management
  • You have experience using talent market insights and data to influence decisions within leadership groups and cross-functional teams
  • You like to build new processes and iterate to improve efficiency along the way

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

title: French Speaking- Account Executive
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

As an Account Executive, you will be managing consultative sales cycles with our Wealth Managers, Multi-Family Offices, and Family offices. We are looking for a proven consultative account executive who exemplifies our values around client centricity and has a demonstrated track record of crafting and delivering exceptional client outcomes. In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop and implement strategies that help Addepar grow new annual recurring revenue and advise our mid-tier clients. This role works in a cross-functional environment with Marketing, Pre-sales, Partnerships, Services, Client Experience & Success, Account Management, and R&D to deliver trusted and scalable solutions. The candidate will demonstrate strong selling skills coupled with a genuine curiosity to learn and a passion for being part of an extraordinary team. The Account Executive is empowered and responsible to lead efforts that result in quota achievement and multi-year client contracts.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

At Addepar you will have the opportunity to reshape the industry and usher in a new era of technology innovation across the Wealth Management Sector for Wealth Managers and Family offices. This role is for someone who has shown to be both a thought leader and execution leader, partnering with the client and your Addepar colleagues to ensure a world-class client experience throughout the entire client journey from pre-sale to post-sale. This role affords the candidate with an opportunity to be both a student and teacher as we work together to deliver a new paradigm across global wealth management.

The Account Executive is expected to own and drive the strategy for this sector, and lead the sales cycle with a cross-functional team with a special focus on helping Addepar grow its business in EMEA and beyond.   

  • Craft Wealth Management and Family Office engagement strategies based on the Addepar GTM model and your experiences as a key contributor
  • Bring your best practices to Addepar and teach us what has made you wildly successful throughout your career. We are always looking to learn and improve the model that best serves our clients
  • Collaborate with your colleagues across Product, Engineering, Services, and more
  • Timely and accurate pipeline and forecast management to help drive cross-functional alignment and expectations
  • Engagement at C-level in enterprise client organisations and within Addepar
  • Develop required client relationships and executive engagement to support long-term success

Who You Are

As a proven Account Executive, you will likely have demonstrated ability in sales or the equivalent degree of expertise in a similar environment. We are interested in individuals with a genuine passion and consistent track record for building and delivering extraordinary client outcomes.

  • Fluent in French with a proven track record of successful sales experience across EMEA.
    Proven successful experience in leading sales cycles
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven experience selling to Wealth Managers, Family and Multi- Family offices, managing complex deals across all levels of a client’s organisation
  • Excellent presentation and executive engagement skills
  • Excellent negotiation skills
  • A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior AI / GenAI Engineer who combines strong Python engineering skills with practical experience building production-oriented RAG and Agentic AI solutions.

Core Requirements

Python Engineering

  • Strong hands-on Python programmingskills with a sound understanding of OOP and software engineering principles.
  • Ability to write clean, modular, maintainable and production-quality code.
  • Experience developing APIs using Python frameworks; FastAPI is preferred.

RAG

  • Hands-on experience implementing an end-to-end RAG pipeline, covering data ingestion, retrieval, context preparation and response generation.
  • Practical experience with retrieval techniques such as:
    • Hybrid search/retrieval
    • Reranking
    • Query rewriting
  • Exposure to advanced RAG approaches such as Agentic RAG, Corrective RAG and HyDE.
  • Understanding of RAG/LLM response evaluation, preferably using frameworks such as RAGAS or TruLens.

Agentic AI

  • Hands-on experience building agent-based AI workflowsusing an orchestration framework, preferably LangGraph or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of agent workflow design, including nodes, edges, state management and orchestration.
  • Experience integrating LLMs with tools/tool calling.
  • Understanding or implementation experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Graph Databases

  • Practical hands-on experience with a graph database, such as Neo4j or equivalent.

Azure / Cloud

  • Hands-on cloud implementation experience; Azure is preferred.
  • Relevant experience may include:
    • Azure AI Search
    • Azure Cosmos DB
    • Azure AI Document Intelligence
    • Azure AI Foundry
    • Azure Application Insights

Added Advantage

Exposure to data engineering technologies such as:

  • Apache Airflow
  • PySpark
  • Azure Data Factory

What We Specifically Look For

We are looking for someone with strong engineering ownership who can independently initiate and drive work rather than wait for detailed instructions.

The candidate should be able to:

  • Understand the business problem and objectivebehind a technical requirement.
  • Consider cost, budget and operational implicationswhen making engineering decisions.
  • Independently structure the technical approach and drive implementation.
  • Challenge or improve existing approaches when there is a better solution.
  • Demonstrate strong coding and problem-solving ability, not just theoretical GenAI knowledge.
  • Show genuine passion for engineering and AI, with evidence of personally building, experimenting and solving real-world problems.

This is not a purely theoretical or prompt-engineering role. We are looking for a strong programmer and hands-on AI engineer who can take GenAI solutions from problem definition through implementation and connect the technology to measurable business needs.

title: Associate Manager, Data Operations
description:

About the Role

As Manager of Data Operations, you will lead the day-to-day execution of Anaplan’s revenue data programs and support the health of our Go-To-Market (GTM) data ecosystem. You will manage a team of data operations specialists, partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and GTM Operations, and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data across our GTM systems. This position reports to the Director of GTM Technology & Data Operations and plays an important cross-functional role in maintaining data quality standards and driving operational improvements. As this role supports global projects across AMER, EMEA, and APAC, the successful candidate will be required to work flexible hours to accommodate different time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Data Strategy & Governance

  • Contribute to and execute against the data stewardship roadmap, supporting data ownership practices across GTM systems in alignment with direction from senior leadership.
  • Partner with stakeholders in Sales, Marketing, and IT to understand priorities and translate them into actionable data operations work.
  • Participate in cross-functional initiatives including territory planning, system migrations, and product launches, serving as the data operations point of contact.
  • Maintain and improve comprehensive documentation for data processes, governance standards, and system workflows.
  • Uphold data quality standards across GTM systems and work with cross-functional partners to address gaps and drive accountability.

Data Quality & Enrichment

  • Manage the execution of data enrichment programs, leveraging tools such as ZoomInfo RingLead and D&B Connect to improve the completeness and depth of the GTM database. Coordinate with Marketing Operations.
  • Support the definition and monitoring of data quality SLAs in partnership with Sales, Marketing, and GTM Ops, tracking outcomes and escalating issues as needed.
  • Foster a proactive data quality culture through regular audits, cleansing routines, and ongoing stakeholder communication.
  • Participate in the enterprise data governance framework as a GTM data representative, helping to implement policy and maintain compliance standards alongside the global Data Governance team.

Data Operations Execution

  • Manage and continuously improve automation workflows for data management, including de-duplication, validation, and process automation in Salesforce and connected systems.
  • Execute data-driven database hygiene campaigns to maintain database integrity, reduce sales friction, and improve marketing segmentation effectiveness.
  • Prepare and share data quality reporting and operational status updates for stakeholders at the manager and director level.
  • Support the evaluation of data tooling and assist in managing vendor relationships; provide input on tool performance and usage.
  • Contribute to the data operations technology roadmap by identifying operational gaps and recommending solutions in partnership with leadership.
  • Identify opportunities for AI-assisted data operations using tools such as Gemini Enterprise, implementing automations that reduce manual effort and improve data quality.
  • Assist with tracking data operations spend and surface efficiency opportunities to leadership.

Team Leadership

  • Manage, mentor, and develop a team of data operations professionals; foster a collaborative, high-accountability team culture.
  • Support team members' professional growth through regular coaching, feedback, and performance conversations.
  • Coordinate team workload, set clear priorities, and ensure the team delivers against commitments on time and at quality.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data operations, data management, or business operations in a SaaS or technology company.
  • 2+ years of direct people management experience, with demonstrated success leading a data operations team or function.
  • Experience working cross-functionally and building productive relationships with peers in Sales, Marketing, and Operations.
  • Comfortable presenting data quality metrics and operational updates to manager- and director-level stakeholders.

Technical Skills

  • Core Data & CRM: Salesforce (Expert); SQL (proficient in querying, validation, and analysis)
  • Data Integration & Warehousing: Informatica; Reverse ETL tools; Google BigQuery
  • BI & Reporting: Tableau
  • Data Enrichment & AI: ZoomInfo RingLead; D&B Connect; Gemini Enterprise
  • GTM System Architecture: Familiarity with data flows for Marketing Automation Platforms (e.g., Marketo) and Sales Engagement Platforms (e.g., Outreach)
  • Scripting (Preferred): Python or similar scripting language for data automation and API integration
  • Advanced Excel skills (complex formulas, power queries, pivot tables)

Core Competencies

  • Operational Excellence: Proven ability to manage and improve data operations processes with measurable outcomes; comfortable working within established frameworks and escalating when needed.
  • Process Improvement: Experience implementing or refining processes around data stewardship, integrity, deduplication, and validation.
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills to troubleshoot database issues and translate data findings into clear, actionable business insights.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate with peers, align stakeholders, and convey data topics clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Vendor Coordination: Experience supporting vendor relationships and tracking tool performance and contract details.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.  
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

description:

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead Addepar’s Files Platform.

Files touch nearly every workflow at Addepar: client reporting, alternatives document lineage, collaboration with external parties like tax advisors, and audit trails for sophisticated global firms. As we serve more large RIAs, family offices, banks, and alternatives-heavy institutions, how we manage documents becomes a core differentiator for client trust and platform value.

We're replatforming our file management experience onto an enterprise content partner (Box), creating a foundation for stronger search, metadata, permissions, sharing, and workflow capabilities. This role owns what comes next: taking that foundation and turning it into an intelligent document workflow layer that serves clients, internal teams, and downstream product surfaces.

On the platform side, you'll shape commercial and technical strategy around a major partner integration, deciding where Addepar should leverage vendor capabilities versus where we build differentiated product, workflow, and API surfaces. On the intelligence side, you'll define how capabilities like document summarization, auto-classification, content-based search, and workflow automation can make file management meaningfully smarter for enterprise users while maintaining the auditability and permissioning controls they require.

You'll own product strategy and execution across migration completion, platform buildout, and roadmap definition. This is a cross-functional role that requires aligning engineering, design, security, legal, and client-facing teams around a shared vision for how files work at Addepar.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

  • Own product strategy end-to-end for the Files Platform, from migration completion through next-generation search, metadata, sharing, workflow, and API capabilities
  • Drive product discovery across user groups (advisors, operations, end clients, API consumers, internal teams) and translate findings into a prioritized roadmap
  • Align multiple product and engineering teams around a unified Files vision, building a true platform that delivers value across Addepar solutions including reporting, Portal, Alternatives, ADM, and more.
  • Own the roadmap for a substantial product area, balancing migration / parity work, urgent client needs, platform foundations, technical dependencies, compliance requirements, partner capabilities, and longer-term strategic opportunities.
  • Deliver a modern files experience with improvements to file search, filtering, sharing, metadata organization, and high-volume upload/download workflows
  • Make build-vs-partner decisions, determining where Addepar should leverage our content platform partner versus where we need differentiated product, workflow, or data capabilities
  • Abstract common document workflow needs from downstream teams (reporting, Portal, Alternatives, ADM) into reusable platform capabilities that accelerate product velocity across Addepar
  • Build intelligent document capabilities like summarization, auto-classification, content-based search, and workflow automation with appropriate enterprise controls around permissioning and auditability
  • Own migration and adoption outcomes, ensuring clients move to the new platform with minimal disruption and clear value unlocks
  • Define success metrics (adoption, search effectiveness, API usage, migration progress, support volume, client satisfaction) and communicate progress to leadership
  • Influence senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Security, Legal, Operations, and Client Success, making tradeoffs across user needs, technical constraints, compliance, and commercial value

Who You Are

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, or equivalent industry / subject matter expertise in fintech, SaaS, enterprise software, data platforms, workflow products, document management, collaboration tools, or infrastructure-heavy product areas.
  • A track record of owning product strategy and execution end-to-end, from discovery through launch, adoption, and measurable outcomes. You are data-driven and impact-oriented.
  • A strong systems thinker comfortable with technically complex products involving APIs, permissioning, metadata, search, migrations, integrations, and data models
  • A clear and persuasive communicator; you simplify complexity and build alignment across product, engineering, design, security, legal, and go-to-market

  • Commercially thoughtful, with the ability to connect Files Platform investments to client adoption, retention, expansion, operational efficiency, partner strategy, and future monetization opportunities.
  • Interested in the future of intelligent document workflows, including how AI, metadata, search, classification, summarization, and workflow automation can make enterprise file systems more useful, secure, and actionable.
  • Thrives in complex, high-ownership environments where the work involves both near-term execution and long-term platform strategy across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
